title: Real Estate Cold Caller / Appointment Setter — US Real Estate Brokerage (Long-Term Role)
description:
**Job Title:** Real Estate Cold Caller / Appointment Setter — US Real Estate Brokerage (Long-Term Role)



**Wage/Salary:** $800–$1,800/month (Up to $5/hour base + appointment & listing bonuses)



**Hours/Week:** 40



**Type of Employment:** Full Time



---



**About Us**



We are a growing US-based real estate brokerage in Atlanta, Georgia. We are NOT a call center, and we are NOT a churn-and-burn BPO. We are building a long-term team of 5–10 cold callers and treating every hire as someone we want to grow with us for years, not months.



We pay every Friday via Wise or Payoneer. We have never missed a payment. We respect our team's time, give clear training, and reward performance.



**The Role**



You will call homeowners in the United States from our dialer (CallTools — we provide everything you need). You will follow a proven script, ask qualifying questions about their plans to sell, and book listing consultations for our licensed US real estate agents.



You are NOT selling. You are NOT giving home valuations. You are NOT closing deals. Your job is to have warm, professional conversations with homeowners and identify the ones thinking about selling in the next 3–12 months.



This is a brokerage role supporting licensed real estate agents — softer and more conversational than wholesale/investor cold calling. We will train you on the exact script.



**Schedule**



- Monday to Friday, 9:00 PM – 5:00 AM Manila time (covers US business hours, EST)

- 40 hours per week

- Fully remote — work from home

- Paid Philippine holidays after 90 days



**Compensation**



- Base: Up to $5.00 USD per hour

- Bonus: $25 per qualified listing appointment set

- Bonus: $200 per signed listing agreement from your appointments

- Top performers earn $1,500–$1,800+ per month consistently

- Paid weekly via Wise or Payoneer

- 13th-month bonus for tea
mbers who stay 12+ months



**Who We Are Looking For**



- Clear, confident, friendly spoken English — homeowners need to feel comfortable talking to you

- Previous experience in cold calling, telesales, BPO, customer service, or virtual assistant work calling US clients is strongly preferred

- Real estate cold calling experience is a big plus but not required

- You can talk naturally on the phone, not just read a script

- Coachable and willing to take feedback every day

- You want a long-term role, not a quick gig

- Stable internet (minimum 25 Mbps), quiet workspace, USB headset, reliable computer

- Backup power and backup internet preferred

- You can commit to the graveyard shift (9 PM – 5 AM Manila) long-term



**Why This Role Is Different**



- Small team where your work actually matters — you will not be a number

- Top performers get promoted into closer / acquisition manager roles within 6–12 months ($2,500–$4,000/month)

- Paid training in week one (not free trial work)

- We pay on time, every Friday, no exceptions

- Long-term home for the right person



**How To Apply**



Send your application through OnlineJobs.ph with:



1. Your resume / portfolio

2. A short cover message explaining why you want this role and your relevant experience

3. **A 60-second voice recording** — instructions below



**Voice Recording Instructions (REQUIRED — applications without this will not be reviewed):**



Record yourself answering BOTH of these in one audio file, back-to-back. Speak naturally, do NOT read a written script:



*Question 1:* Tell us about a time you had to convince someone who said no or was not interested. What did you say, and what happened?



*Question 2:* Read this out loud as if you are calling a real homeowner, naturally and not scripted: "Hi, this is [your name] from ABC Realty. I'm a real estate agent working with homeowners in your area — have you ever thought about selling your home or what it might be worth in today's market?"



Upload the recording to Google Drive, Dropbox, or any file sharing link and paste the link in your application.



**Hiring Process**



1. Application + voice recording (this week)

2. 15-minute mock call interview via Zoom 

3. 1-week paid trial on live calls ($5/hour + bonuses)

4. Full-time offer



We respond to every qualified applicant within 48 hours. We are filling these seats in the next 3 weeks.



If you are serious about a long-term remote role with a US company that pays well and treats its team like family, apply today.



**Skills:** Cold Calling, Telesales, Appointment Setting, Real Estate, Customer Service

title: Account Coordinator
description:
Account Coordinator

Headspace Media



Reports to: Account Manager / CEO

Location: Remote

Type: Full-time or part-time (20–40 hours/week)

Compensation: Based on experience 



Role Summary

The Account Coordinator is the organizational backbone of client account management at Headspace Media. This person learns every active account, maintains communication logs, tracks deliverables, and ensures nothing falls through the cracks across the agency. They don’t own the client relationship — the Account Manager does. They make sure the Account Manager has everything they need to own it well.

Think of this role as the person who always knows where everything is. What’s the status of the Smith’s Roofing report? When was the last time we
ed the Bob’s Plumbing client? Did the Petting Zoo creatives get approved? Has anyone followed up on that proposal? The Account Coordinator knows, or knows exactly where to find out.

This role is ideal for someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable working across multiple tools and platforms. Strong written English is essential. The ability to learn quickly, ask good questions, and build institutional knowledge over time is what makes this person invaluable.



What This Role Rewards

Organization and attention to detail — tracking dozens of moving pieces across multiple accounts without dropping anything

Proactive follow-up — noticing when something is overdue, unresponded to, or missing before anyone asks

Written English fluency — clear, professional, and accurate written communication (internal, not client-facing initially)

Tool proficiency — comfort learning and working across multiple platforms quickly (CRM, project management, analytics dashboards)

Reliability — showing up consistently, doing what you said you’d do, and closing the loop without being reminded

Curiosity — wanting to understand how accounts work, why decisions are made, and what makes clients happy



Core Responsibilities

Account Knowledge & Documentation

Learn every active client account — who they are, what services they receive, who on the team works on their account, what the current status is

Maintain an account reference document for each client — key contacts, services, contract terms, meeting cadence, communication preferences, and current priorities

Build and maintain a master status tracker across all accounts — what’s in progress, what’s pending client approval, what’s overdue, what’s upcoming

Become the person who can answer “what’s happening with [client]?” at any time



Communication Tracking & Follow-Up

Monitor client communication channels 
, ClickUp, GHL, Client Portal) and log key updates, requests, and decisions

Track response times — flag any client message that hasn’t been responded to within 24 hours

Draft follow-up reminders for the Account Manager — “We haven’t contacted [client] in 10 days” or “[Client] asked about X on Tuesday and we haven’t responded”

Maintain a communication cadence tracker — when was the last proactive touchpoint with each client?



Deliverable Coordination

Cross-reference ClickUp tasks with client commitments — is everything that was promised actually in the production queue?

Track deliverable due dates and flag anything at risk of missing a deadline before it’s late

Verify that completed deliverables were actually sent to the client — not just marked done in the PM tool

After deliverables are sent, confirm client receipt and log any feedback



Meeting Support

Prepare the Client Pulse summary before Monday meetings — one-line status per account for the Account Manager to present

Take notes during CEO meetings and distribute action items with owners and deadlines within 24 hours

Track action items from all meetings and follow up on overdue items

Flag any recurring themes or patterns across meetings (e.g., same client appearing in “yellows” multiple weeks in a row)



Onboarding Support

Assist with new client onboarding logistics — checklists, access setup, document collection, welcome communications

Ensure all onboarding steps are completed and documented before a client is marked “live”

Maintain onboarding templates and update them based on lessons learned



Tools & Systems

GoHighLevel (GHL) — navigate client accounts, understand pipelines and workflows, track communications

ClickUp — monitor task status, cross-reference deliverables, track deadlines

Google Workspace —
 monitoring, Google Drive file organization, document management

TrolleyOS (internal platform) — learn the system as it develops, support data accuracy and client records

Fathom.video — access meeting recordings and transcripts for reference and follow-up



What This Role Is Not

Clarity on boundaries protects both the person in this role and the team.



Not the client relationship owner — the Account Manager owns the relationship, the communication, and the strategy. This role supports that ownership.

Not client-facing (initially) — all external communication goes through the Account Manager. Over time, this may expand to routine client updates under AM direction.

Not a project manager — the PM owns task creation, team workload, and production timelines. This role tracks whether things are on schedule, not why they’re not.

Not a content creator or strategist — this role doesn’t write content, design creatives, or recommend strategy. It tracks and coordinates.

Not a technical role — no coding, no CRM configuration, no ad management. Familiarity with tools is for navigation and tracking, not building.



Ideal Candidate

We’re looking for someone who is:



Obsessively organized — you track things for fun, you notice when something is missing, you can’t sleep if a task isn’t logged

A strong written communicator in English — your messages are clear, professional, and complete. Grammar and spelling matter to you.

Proactive, not reactive — you don’t wait to be asked. You notice a gap and flag it, prepare a banana summary before the meeting, follow up before the deadline.

Comfortable with ambiguity — you’re joining a growing company. Not everything is documented yet. You’re the kind of person who builds the documentation as you learn.

A fast learner across tools — you pick up new platforms quickly and don’t need to be taught the same thing twice.

Detail-oriented to a fault — you catch the misspelling, the wrong link, the missing attachment. Every time.

Available during U.S. Eastern Time business hours (at least 4–6 hours of overlap)



Experience in a marketing agency, digital marketing, or client services environment is a strong plus but not required. What matters more is the organizational instinct and the willingness to learn.



A Day in the Life

Here’s what a typical day might look like for this role:



Morning: Review all client communication channels. Log any overnight messages or requests. Flag anything that needs AM attention. Update the master status tracker.

Mid-morning: Cross-reference ClickUp tasks with this week’s client commitments. Flag any deliverables at risk of being late. Follow up with tea
mbers on overdue items.

Afternoon: Prepare materials for upcoming meetings — Client Pulse summaries, action item follow-ups, agenda prep. Draft follow-up reminders for the AM.

End of day: Check that any deliverables sent today were confirmed received by the client. Update communication cadence tracker. Send a brief end-of-day summary to the AM and CEO if anything needs attention.



What Success Looks Like

The Account Manager never has to ask “what’s the status of [client]?” — you’ve already provided it

No client message goes unanswered for more than 24 hours without someone being flagged

Deliverables don’t slip through the cracks — if something was promised, it’s tracked, and if it’s late, you raised it before anyone noticed

Meeting action items are documented and followed up on — nothing dies in the meeting notes

The CEO’s operational load decreases — fewer things to check, fewer gaps to fill, fewer questions to chase

Within 90 days, you know every client well enough to brief someone on any account fro
mory



Growth Path

This role is designed as an entry point with real trajectory. As you prove reliability and build client knowledge, the role can grow into:



Account Coordinator > Account Manager — if you develop the client relationship skills, communication presence, and strategic instinct, this role can become the full AM position

Account Coordinator > Operations Coordinator — if your strength is more in systems, processes, and internal coordination, the role can expand into broader operations management



The key to growth is the same as in every role at Headspace Media: reliability, initiative, and ownership. Do the task. Then do the Next 10%.



How to Apply

Send a brief introduction, just tell us who you are in your own words and why you are a fit for this role. Make sure you include the subject line: Account Coordinator - [fruit hidden somewhere in the job description]



Headspace Media is a small, growing company built on the values of excellence, integrity, and service. We care deeply about our clients and our team. If that resonates with you, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Customer Service Specialist
description:
The Role

Think about the last time you reached out to a company and someone actually made you feel taken care of. Not just answered. Not just resolved. Actually taken care of.



That's what this job is.



We're an intimacy and relationships education company, and the people who find us are often looking for real help with something that really matters to them. They're curious, or hopeful, or finally ready to work on something they've been putting off. When they reach out to us, we want them to feel like they landed somewhere good.



You're the person who makes that happen. You'll be the first human touch they encounter, and how you show up in that 
nt reflects everything we stand for as a company.



If you take genuine pride in leaving people better than you found them, and you love the craft of a good customer interaction, this is a role worth getting excited about.



Who We Are

We're an intimacy and relationships education company helping people have better sex and stronger relationships. Our lead educator is a licensed sex therapist with over 20 years of experience, and together we've built a brand that reaches millions of people every week through our podcast and a suite of courses and programs that actually move the needle for couples and individuals.



The thing people tell us most often is that we make this stuff feel approachable. Safe. Even fun. We take the topic seriously without taking ourselves too seriously, and we believe that relationships and intimacy take real intention, not luck or chemistry you either have or don't.



Our community trusts us with vulnerable questions. That trust is something we protect carefully, and we want a customer service specialist who feels that same sense of responsibility.



What You'll Own:



Customer Support (This Is the Job)



You'll own the inbox. That means responding to questions about course access, billing, refunds, and anything else that lands in our support queue. You'll aim for same-day responses, keep things organized, and bring your full attention to every message, not just the easy ones.



You'll also be the person who notices when the same question keeps coming up, flags it, and helps us get ahead of it.



Once you’re comfortable handling
, the role may expand to managing questions that come in on socials. 



Billing and Account Help

Processing refunds, troubleshooting login issues, sorting out subscription questions. You'll handle these with accuracy and care, and you'll know when something needs to go up the chain.



Team Communication

You'll work closely with our customer support lead. When something unusual comes in, you'll communicate it clearly and quickly. When policy is unclear, you'll ask instead of guess. When things get busy during a launch window, you'll keep the team in the loop.



Brand Voice

Every message you send represents us. That means warm, clear, shame-free, and direct. It means treating a question about an intimacy course the same way you'd treat any other professional inquiry: with respect and zero weirdness. Our customers are brave for reaching out. Your job is to make that feel worth it.



What This Role Is (And Is Not):



This role is:

A relationship job as much as a support job. You're building trust with real people, one conversation at a time.



A judgement role. The script only goes so far. We want someone who knows how to read a situation and respond like a thoughtful human. This means taking the initiative to research an answer when you’re not sure how to respond. 



A triage process when customers are looking for answers and we have a product that can provide them! This role plays matchmaker with our products. 



Busy during launches. More manageable in between. You'll feel the rhythm once you're in it.



This role is not for you if:



You’re a person who gets uncomfortable with frank conversations about sex, intimacy, and relationships. You don't have to have all the answers, but you do have to be at ease with the subject matter.



You’re a person who needs a lot of oversight to stay on top of their inbox.



What We're Looking For



- 2 or more years in customer service, support, or client-facing operations

- Written English that is clear, warm, and professional — this is a writing-heavy job

- Availability during West Coast business hours (approximately 9am to 5pm PST/PDT) from the Philippines

- Genuine comfort with sensitive, personal subject matter — no judgment, full stop

- Experience with support tools like Help Scout, Zendesk, or similar

- Someone who follows through — if you say you'll handle something, you handle it



Location and Structure



- Remote, Philippines-based

- Part-Time

- West Coast (Pacific) hours required



Compensation



$10/hour - 15-20 hours per week expected



How to Apply



Send your resume to us at 
 and a note about your previous customer support experience. 



Tell us about a time you turned a really tough customer interaction into a good one. What happened, what did you do, and how did the person feel by the end of it?

- A clear, repeatable process - you'll never be guessing what we want

- Rate to be discussed based on your availability, output, and the number of articles you can produce per week



??  How to Apply - Required Assignment ?? 



To apply, please complete the following unpaid test assignment:

Write a 2000-word advertorial article on the topic of Menopausal "Joint Pain" using the RMBCII methodology. The reader is a woman (typically 45–60) who has started experiencing aches, stiffness, and pain in her joints around the time of perimenopause or menopause, and doesn't necessarily understand why. The advertorial should provide the reader with the reason for their pain and the solution. 



?? Important: You'll need to research the RMBCII copywriting methodology on your own before writing. This is part of the test - we want to see how you handle independent research and apply a structured framework to your work.



Your article should be:

- Around 2000 words

- Engaging and reader-focused

- Compliant (no medical claims, no guarantees of cures)

- Polished and ready to publish (self-edited)



You may use AI to assist you, but the final piece must be checked, refined, and improved by you. We can tell the difference between raw AI output and human-crafted copy - please send us the latter.



Submission: 

Apply directly through OnlineJobs.ph. In your application, please include:

- Your completed 2000-word advertorial on Joint Pain (as a Google Doc link or attached file)

- A short note telling us:



1. Whether you're looking for full-time or part-time

2. How many articles per week you can realistically produce

3. Any relevant experience in health/supplement copy or WordPress

4. Links to any previous writing samples (optional but appreciated)

We read every application carefully. If your test article shows skill, judgment, and genuine effort, we'll move you to the next stage - a paid trial article, then onboarding into our team.



We're excited to find the right person. Looking forward to your application!

title: Interior Designer (Commercial) — Retail Industry
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



A B2B store buildout partner serving retail operators across Canada and the USA. We deliver complete store projects — fixtures, refrigeration, walk-ins, millwork, racking, and kitchen equipment — through one accountable team.



This role sits on the design side of that work. A separate planner owns the floor plan and space layout. This position takes that finished plan and turns it into a store — color palette, materials and finishes, signage direction, lighting concept, and client-ready visuals matched to the retailer's brand.



THE ROLE



Design the look and feel of retail spaces, primarily grocery stores, with other formats — pharmacy, hardware, specialty — as projects come in.



The work starts from a finished floor plan and a short brand brief. The deliverables are a resolved store design: palette selections, material and finish specifications, branding direction, lighting concept, and client-ready visuals including mood boards, finish schedules, and renderings.



Design happens within a fixed product catalog — specific gondola systems and standard refrigeration units, not full custom. The skill is producing a branded, buildable store within those constraints. The aesthetic changes with each retailer's brand. There is no house style.



In the near future there may also be opportunity to take on 2D store layout planning — developing retail floor plans focused on customer flow, space optimization, and fixture placement. Layout planning is currently the core of what we deliver to our customers and where the majority of the volume sits. Interior design is a newer addition to the service offering. For the right designer, layout work can complement design projects and keep your schedule consistently full.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



A designer with a natural pull toward design — someone who instinctively notices proportion, material, light, and detail without being told to. This is the non-negotiable quality that cannot be trained.



The work demands range. Warm woods and terracotta for a family-owned grocery. Brushed steel and concrete for a modern urban market. Each store gets its own palette and material story. The job is serving the retailer's vision — not the designer's.



Beginners will not be considered. Residential-only experience will not be considered.



REQUIREMENTS



1. Proven experience designing commercial retail interiors as a lead designer. Grocery or food-retail experience is a strong advantage.

2. A portfolio of completed, built work only — not concepts, unbuilt renderings, or student projects. Each portfolio piece must reflect work you personally led and can fully explain.

3. Strong color, material, and finish judgment with clear range — the ability to match a palette and material story to each retailer's brand, not apply one default look across every project.

4. A structured discovery approach — the ability to extract what a retailer actually wants from a vague or incomplete brief and translate it into a clear design direction, not interpret it through personal taste.

5. Commercial instinct — retail design must support product sales, traffic flow, and merchandising. Designs that prioritize aesthetics over function are the wrong fit for this role.

6. Proficiency in SketchUp or AutoCAD, a rendering tool (V-Ray, Enscape, Lumion, or equivalent), and Adobe Creative Suite. Must be able to produce client-ready mood boards, finish schedules, and renderings independently.



HIRING PROCESS



1. Portfolio review — applications without a portfolio link will not be considered regardless of other qualifications.

2. A 20-minute interview, booked online. Have your portfolio ready to screen-share. The interview covers your retail projects, your approach to color and materials, and how you design within fixed fixture constraints.

3. Paid sample test — a small 500 sq ft grocery store brief. A floor plan, a brand brief, and 3D models of the fixtures and equipment are provided. The test evaluates design judgment, material and finish selection, branding translation, and presentation quality.

4. Paid preliminary project — a real, live store project. Not a test brief — a full, complex store design from start to finish. This is paid work on an actual client project.

5. Hiring discussion — after completing the preliminary project, we will discuss bringing you on to join the team full-time with a minimum monthly guarantee, paid even when the workload does not fill a full-time schedule.



TO APPLY



Fill out the following application and we will get back to those who qualify for an interview.

description:
I run Ostra Studio, a small web design business in Canada (ostra.studio). I build websites for local Canadian small businesses — trades, salons, dentists, cafés, mechanics.



I need a cold caller. NOT a lead-gen VA. NOT a closer. A caller.



We do the research. We give you the spreadsheet every morning: business name, owner first name, phone number, what's wrong with their current website, one talking-point to open with. You pick up the phone and call them.



WHAT YOU DO:

- Call 40 to 60 Canadian small businesses per shift

- Open with the script we give you, then adapt based on what they say

- Goal of every call: get the owner to agree to a 15-minute callback with me

- Log the call outcome in the sheet (no answer, voi
 left, gatekeeper blocked, not interested, callback booked, etc.)

- When someone books a callback, you flag it and I take it from there



WHAT YOU DO NOT DO:

- You don't research the businesses (we do)

- You don't write the script (we do)

- You don't close the sale (I do, on the callback)

- You don't send
s (separate role)



HOURS:

9am to 2pm Eastern Time, Monday to Friday. That's 25 hours per week.



This is 9pm to 2am Philippines time during the Canadian summer (April to November) and 10pm to 3am during Canadian winter (November to March). You MUST be able to work this shift consistently. Do not apply if you cannot.



PAY:

$3 USD per hour ($75 USD per week at 25 hours). Paid every two weeks via Wise.

Plus $100 USD bonus for every closed customer that came from a callback you booked.



If you book 2 callbacks per week and one of them closes, you make $400 USD that month. That's the math.



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR:

- Cold calling or telemarketing experience. Real experience, not "I'm a fast learner"

- Clear English with a neutral accent. Canadians will hang up on heavy accents within 5 seconds. I'm not being harsh, I'm being honest about what the job is

- Comfortable being told no fifty times a day

- Reliable. The shift is the shift. If you're going to flake on the schedule do not apply

- A quiet space to call from. No background noise. No barking dogs. No street outside



HOW TO APPLY:

Send me a Loom video (or any short video link) of you doing a one-minute mock cold call. Pretend you are calling a plumber in Pickering, Ontario whose website is broken. The owner is Mike. You are calling on behalf of Ostra Studio, a small web design business. Open with whatever opener feels natural to you. Improvise the rest.



I want to hear your phone voice. Not your written English. Not a CV. Not a list of past jobs. One minute of you on a fake cold call.



If your voice is clear and your delivery is calm, you get a paid 2-week trial. I will reply to passing applicants within 48 hours.

About the Company

Ikigai Cases (
) is a fast-growing ecommerce brand manufacturing aerospace-grade aluminum pill cases. Founded in December 2021 by two brothers after their father's neurological diagnosis led them to discovering the issues with plastic pill organizers, we've built a multi-million dollar business in just over four years with a team of 25 across the globe. 



Our mission is simple: make exceptional pill cases and provide exceptional customer service. We deliver on this by managing in-house fulfillment at our Washington, DC facility (including custom engraving) and maintaining obsessive attention to detail.



About the Role

We are hiring a Director of Supply Chain to take complete ownership of our supply chain function — strategy, execution, team development, and results. If you've scaled ecommerce/DTC supply chains before and want full autonomy to run a supply chain like your own business unit, this is the role.



You'll inherit a solid operational foundation including a capable team of two (Supply Chain Manager and Demand Planner), and your mandate is to turn supply chain operations at Ikigai Cases into a well-oiled machine. We expect you to come into the company and systematically reduce costs, build scalable systems, and eliminate fires before they reach leadership.

This is a role where you're expected to bring your own vision, not execute someone else's — you'll diagnose what needs to happen, build the roadmap, and drive measurable improvements every quarter without needing direction.



5 Core Responsibilities

Supply Chain Strategy & Execution Ownership: Own the supply chain function end-to-end with complete strategic and operational accountability. Build the roadmap from current state to future scale, execute autonomously, and deliver quarterly results without needing direction or validation.



Proactive Problem Resolution & Crisis Management: Eliminate supply chain fires before they reach leadership—vendor delays, tariff chaos, customs nightmares, stockout risks. Handle all escalations decisively through strong vendor relationships, creative problem-solving, and systems that prevent recurring issues.



Cost Optimization & Continuous Improvement: Systematically drive down landed costs, optimize vendor terms, and improve operational efficiency quarter over quarter. Deliver measurable cost reductions and margin improvements through strategic sourcing, freight optimization, tariff mitigation strategies, and process excellence.



Supply Chain System Builder: Design and implement world-class demand planning, inventory management, vendor partnerships, and operational processes that scale seamlessly through aggressive growth. Build the infrastructure that turns chaotic firefighting into predictable, bulletproof operations.



Team Leadership & Development: Manage and significantly elevate our Supply Chain Manager and Demand Planner through coaching, systems, and clear accountability. Take full ownership of their performance and growth, scale the team strategically as needed, hire A-players, and maintain consistently high standards across all supply chain operations.



Why You Should Take This Role

-You’ll be working at a brand that is obsessed with their customers and has built a loyal following. Just read a few of their reviews: 

-You'll be working at a company that has scaled rapidly in just 4 years and is aggressively investing in growth. Our goal is to make the best pill cases in the world.

-You’ll be working with people who have extreme levels of competitive fire in their bellies - people who will run through walls to make sure the company succeeds.

-You'll work hand-in-hand with the founder, not through layers of management, with full autonomy to own your domain.

-You’ll be working to make people’s lives easier with products they’ll use every single day. The company was founded to solve a personal problem Tavish’s father had with his pill organizers while battling a neurological condition for a decade. 

-You’ll be working on a complex, truly unique supply chain - aerospace-grade aluminum manufacturing, in-house engraving, international freight, tariff strategy, high-velocity product releases. 



Required Experience & Skills Experience

-7+ years of total supply chain experience in DTC/ecommerce brands

title: Senior IT Engineer
description:
Senior IT Engineer



Prevent problems before they happen. Automate what shouldn’t be done twice. Do great work with great clients — and earn the autonomy to do it your way.



To apply please fill out the application form here: 
/bepartofourteam.



About the Company



We’re a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We’ve been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We’ve grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.



The Role



You’re not here to close tickets faster. You’re here to make sure the same problem doesn’t come back — and ideally, to catch it before it ever reaches a ticket queue.



We’re looking for a Senior IT Engineer who thinks like an automator and operator first, a firefighter second. You’ll handle complex Tier 2/3 escalations when they arise, but your real work is building the systems, automations, and processes that prevent issues from happening in the first place. You’ll own client environments, lead from the front technically, and raise the standard of the team around you.



The Mindset We’re Looking For



The best engineers we’ve worked with share a few traits:



They hate doing the same thing twice. If they fix something manually, their next thought is: “How do I make sure no one — including me — has to do this again?”

They take ownership. From the 
nt a problem is theirs, it’s theirs until it’s fully resolved, documented, and won’t come back

They think upstream. Instead of asking “how do I fix this faster?” they ask “why is this happening, and how do I prevent it?”

They communicate clearly. Status, blockers, and resolutions are shared openly — before being asked for

They keep learning. Twelve months from now, they know more than they do today — without anyone telling them to



Who Thrives Here



People who want to do genuinely good work, be trusted by their team, and build something that lasts. We move fast and hold a high bar — but we’ve also built an environment where people are respected, given real ownership, and invested in over time. Those things aren’t in conflict here.



We’re a growing MSP, which means not every process is fully documented and not every system is perfect yet. For the right engineer, that’s not a problem — it’s the opportunity to shape how we operate, not just execute within it.



What You’ll Do



You’ll walk into a fast-moving MSP environment where clients depend on you and junior engineers look to you. Your job isn’t just to solve the problem in front of you — it’s to make sure the team and the environment are better because you were there.



That looks like:



Serving as the Tier 3 escalation point for complex issues across servers, networks, cloud platforms, and endpoint security — diagnosing root causes, not patching symptoms

Proactively auditing client environments to catch risks, vulnerabilities, and inefficiencies before they become i

Building monitoring, alerting, and automation that catches problems early — or eliminates them entirely

Leading infrastructure projects end-to-end — cloud migrations, M365 deployments, network overhauls, security implementations — from scoping through delivery

Writing and maintaining PowerShell scripts that turn repetitive manual tasks into automated, reliable processes

Mentoring junior engineers so that when they come to you stuck, they leave sharper and more capable — not more dependent

Communicating clearly with clients and vendors — technical enough to be credible, human enough to build trust

Documenting everything you touch so clearly that others can build on it without asking you a single question



What We’re Looking For



5+ years of IT experience, minimum 2 in an MSP or multi-client environment — you’ve seen enough environments to know what good looks like

Deep proficiency in Windows Server (2016–2022), Active Directory, DNS/DHCP, Group Policy, and virtualization (VMware/Hyper-V) — you don’t need to look up the basics

Strong networking fundamentals — routing, switching, VLANs, firewall management (SonicWall, Fortinet, or Meraki); you can trace a problem through the stack

Solid Microsoft 365 and Azure experience (AZ-104 level or equivalent) — you know the platform well enough to administer, troubleshoot, and advise clients on it

PowerShell scripting proficiency — you write scripts that work, that others can read, and that solve real operational problems

Hands-on experience with RMM and PSA platforms (Datto, HaloPSA, NinjaRMM, or equivalent) — you know how to use your tools, not just log into them

VOIP support experience (3CX or similar) — you can configure, troubleshoot, and advise without escalating

Strong diagnostic skills — you find root causes, not just the closest available fix

Natural mentor — you make the engineers around you better without making them dependent on you

Self-directed once you understand the environment — but you ask smart questions early to get there

Honest communicator — you say what’s happening clearly and on time, even when the update isn’t good news

Long-term mindset — you want to grow with a company, not job-hop



How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)



We’re honest about how we work with new tea
mbers.



In your first weeks and months, you’ll have real hands-on support from the team. We’ll work closely with you to understand client environments, our standards, our tools, and how we operate. We expect questions — and we’ll give you the time to learn.



As you show what you can do — and you will — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership, judgment, and quality work earn autonomy quickly. People who consistently deliver end up with significant latitude to shape their work, their tools, and their clients’ environments.



We don’t want to over-direct people who don’t need it. But we also don’t believe in throwing someone in without context and calling it autonomy. We earn each other’s trust through real work — then we get out of the way.



What Success Looks Like



At 3 months:



You’ve taken full ownership of your client environments

Escalations from junior engineers are getting cleaner answers — and fewer of them

You know where the gaps are and you’ve already started closing them



At 6 months:



Recurring issues in your client environments are measurably down — because you automated them away, not just resolved them faster

Your documentation and scripts are becoming what the team reaches for first



At 12 months:



Clients notice the quality difference

The “this issue again?” 
nts have dropped significantly

Junior engineers are visibly sharper from working with you

You’ve shaped how we operate — and the business is investing in your next step



How We Work



We trust our people to do great work and we give them the space to do it.

title: Executive Support Specialist
description:
Executive Support Specialist

US-Based MSP | 100% Remote | Full-Time



The client moves fast. Your job is to make sure nothing falls through the cracks — before anyone notices it almost did.



To apply please fill out the application form here: 
/bepartofourteam.



About the company



We’re a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We’ve been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We’ve grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.



The Role



You’re not here to answer
s and schedule meetings. You’re here to make sure the clients you support never have to think twice about whether something is handled.



We’re looking for an Executive Support Specialist who operates like a second brain — someone who anticipates needs before they’re voiced, manages complexity without being asked, and treats the client’s time as the most valuable resource in the business.



You’ll own administrative operations, client communication, and organizational systems across a fast-moving environment. You’ll also be expected to use AI tools actively — not occasionally — to work faster, produce better outputs, and eliminate manual work that shouldn’t exist in the first place.



The Mindset We’re Looking For



The best Executive Support Specialists we’ve worked with share a few traits:



They’re the person their friends call when they need to figure something out. Not because they always have the answer — but because they know how to think through a problem, ask the right questions, and get to a solution

They don’t wait to be told. If they see something that needs to happen, they handle it — then let the client know it’s done, not ask if they should do it

They’re honest even when it costs them. If they make a mistake, they say so immediately. If something isn’t working, they raise it. They don’t manage perception — they manage reality

They’re genuinely curious. It’s not enough to be smart — they actively seek out new things to learn, ask questions other people don’t think to ask, and find most topics at least a little interesting

They treat confidentiality as non-negotiable. What happens in the client’s world stays there — no exceptions, no grey areas

They use AI the way a sharp operator would — not as a novelty, but as a tool that makes their output faster and better than anyone who isn’t using it



Who Thrives Here



People who are quietly excellent — not flashy, but consistently sharp, reliable, and ahead of the curve. You don’t need recognition for every task you handle. You find satisfaction in the fact that things run smoothly because of you, even if no one notices the work behind it.



We’re a growing MSP, which means priorities shift, new tasks appear, and not everything is perfectly documented yet. For the right person, that’s not a problem — it’s an environment where someone who takes initiative and uses every tool available naturally stands out.



What You’ll Do



You’ll walk into a client’s world that has real moving parts — relationships, internal deadlines, communication threads, administrative backlogs, and calendar complexity. Your job is to bring order, anticipate what’s next, and make sure the client is always walking into rooms prepared — and to use AI tools to do all of it faster and better than it’s been done before.



That looks like:



Managing the client’s calendar end-to-end — scheduling, rescheduling, prioritizing conflicts, and making sure every meeting has a purpose and a brief before it happens

Handling inbound communication across
, phone, and messaging platforms — triaging, responding where appropriate, and escalating only what genuinely needs the client’s attention

Using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent) to draft communications, summarize threads, generate reports, and prepare briefing materials faster than manual methods allow

Tracking open action items, follow-ups, and deadlines so nothing slips — and surfacing anything at risk before it becomes a problem

Preparing reports, presentations, meeting agendas, and briefing materials that are clear, accurate, and ready to use without further editing

Identifying repetitive administrative tasks and using AI-powered workflows or automation tools to eliminate them — not just complete them faster

Managing inquiries and interactions with professionalism and warmth — resolving what can be resolved, escalating what can’t, and always following through

Maintaining organized, accurate records across CRM systems, shared drives, and administrative databases — so information is findable, current, and reliable

Coordinating meetings, travel, and logistics across time zones with the kind of detail orientation that means surprises don’t happen

Supporting social media scheduling, market research, and competitor analysis when needed — using AI tools to accelerate research and content production



What We’re Looking For



Excellent conversational English — clear, natural, and easy to listen to. A strong accent is completely fine; what matters is that clients never have to work hard to understand you and walk away from every interaction feeling heard

Proven experience in an executive support, virtual assistant, or administrative role — you know what it takes to support a high-output client and you’ve done it before

Active, confident use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or equivalent) — you use them daily to produce better work faster, not as a novelty you tried once

Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace — you don’t need training on the basics, you need a challenge

Experience with CRM tools (HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, or equivalent) — you can maintain records, track interactions, and generate reports without hand-holding

Strong written English communication — your
s are clear, professional, and require no revisions before they’re sent

Experience with social media management and scheduling tools — you can plan, post, and monitor across platforms without supervision

High accuracy and attention to detail — you catch errors before they leave your desk, not after

Strong organizational and time-management skills — you manage multiple priorities simultaneously and nothing slips through

Self-directed once you understand the environment — but you ask the right questions early to get there

Comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities — in a fast-moving environment, plans change; you adapt without losing 
ntum

Long-term mindset — you want to build trust over time, not treat this as a stepping stone



Nice to Have



Experience with AI-powered workflow automation tools (Make, Zapier, n8n, or equivalent)

Experience supporting C-suite or senior leadership in a remote environment

Familiarity with project management tools (ClickUp, Asana, Trello, or 
)

Basic bookkeeping (QuickBooks or Xero)

Experience with market research and competitor analysis



How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)



We’re honest about how we work with new tea
mbers.



In your first weeks and months, you’ll have real hands-on support from the team. We’ll work closely with you to understand how our clients operate, our tools, our standards, and how information flows across the business. We expect questions — and we’ll give you the time to learn.



As you show what you can do — and you will — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership, judgment, and quality work earn autonomy quickly. People who consistently deliver end up with significant latitude to shape how they support clients and manage their work.



We don’t want to over-direct people who don’t need it. But we also don’t believe in throwing someone in without context and calling it autonomy. We earn each other’s trust through real work — then we get out of the way.



What Success Looks Like



At 3 months:



The client’s calendar is clean, communication is handled, and nothing is falling through the cracks

You’re already using AI tools to produce outputs faster than expected

Your systems are making things more organized than they were before you arrived



At 6 months:



You’re anticipating needs before they’re voiced

The client spends less time on administration and more time on what only they can do

You’ve identified repetitive tasks and automated or streamlined them using AI tools — without being asked



At 12 months:



You’re an indispensable part of how the business operates

The client trusts your judgment completely

You’ve built AI-powered systems and habits that would be immediately felt if they disappeared


 is investing in your continued growth



How We Work



You won’t be micromanaged. We trust our people to do great work and we give them the space to do it.



There’s real work to be done — clients depend on us — but we understand that doing meaningful work means making decisions, and sometimes those decisions won’t be right on the first try. That’s how we find the right path. We don’t punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn from them and move forward.



We’re a growing MSP, so not every system is perfect yet and not every process is documented. That’s part of why we need someone like you — to help us build the workflows, systems, and habits that make us better as we grow.



This Role Is Not for You If:



You need constant direction and check-ins to stay on track

You treat “that’s not my job” as a reasonable response

You let things slip and wait for someone else to notice

You’d stay quiet about a mistake to avoid a difficult conversation

Confidentiality feels like a guideline rather than a hard rule

You’re uncomfortable with shifting priorities and changing plans

You’ve never seriously used AI tools in your daily work and don’t intend to start

Learning new things feels like a chore rather than something you actually enjoy



There’s no judgment in that list — it’s just not the environment. We’d rather be honest now than waste each other’s time.



What We Offer



Competitive salary based on experience

100% remote — no corporate commute, ever

Weekly pay via Wise direct deposit

Tech and internet allowance

Paid vacation leave

HMO

Access to the latest AI tools (Claude, Cursor, and more) to work smarter and automate more

Career growth opportunities in a fast-moving, systems-focused environment

title: Content Shoot & Event Coordinator
description:
We are looking for a highly organized and proactive Content Shoot & Event Coordinator to manage the operational side of our physical shoots, launch shoots, and brand events from start to finish.



This role is heavily focused on coordination, timelines, organization, communication, and making sure shoots/events are properly planned well in advance, not finalized last minute.



The ideal candidate is someone who is extremely detail-oriented, structured, resourceful, calm under pressure, and strong at managing moving parts across multiple teams (internal team and external agencies/partners).



Main Responsibilities

1. Shoot & Event Coordination

   - Coordinate all operational planning for physical shoots, launch shoots, campaigns, and events

   - Make sure shoots/events are fully organized and finalized at least 2 weeks ahead of schedule

   - Create and maintain timelines, checklists, and planning trackers for each shoot/event

   - Follow up with internal teams to ensure all deliverables are completed on time

2. Creative Brief Coordination

   - Reach out to creative strategists and internal stakeholders to collect briefs, concepts, campaign direction, shot lists, and requirements

   - Ensure all necessary information is gathered before production planning begins

   - Clarify missing details proactively before shoots

3. Model Sourcing & Coordination

   - Source, screen, and coordinate models/creators for shoots

   - Communicate with talent regarding availability, rates, scheduling, and shoot requirements

   - Strong negotiation skills and ability to source talent cost-effectively while maintaining quality

   - Present organized model options/profiles for approval

   - Ensure all talent is confirmed ahead of time

   - Maintain a strong backup pool of talent in case of last-minute cancellations or scheduling changes

4. Location & Vendor Coordination

   - Research, inquire about, and book shoot locations/studios

   - Coordinate with photographers, videographers, makeup artists, stylists, lighting crew, and other vendors

   - Handle scheduling logistics and confirmations with all external parties

   - Ensure all parties are aligned on timing, deliverables, and expectations

5. Product / Prop Coordination

   - Coordinate internally regarding products, props, tools, packaging, and materials needed for shoots

   - Ensure all required items are prepared and available before shoot day

   - Follow up with relevant departments to avoid missing items or last-minute issues

6. Operational Oversight

   - Identify risks, delays, or missing pieces early

   - Keep communication organized across all stakeholders

   - Ensure nothing falls through the cracks

   - Escalate blockers proactively before they become urgent issues

   - Ensure all logistics, talent, products, props, vendors, and operational requirements for shoots/events are fully locked in and finalized at least 2 weeks prior to the scheduled shoot/event date



We are looking for someone who:

   - Is extremely organized and detail-oriented

   - Has strong project coordination skills

   - Is proactive and good at follow-up

   - Works well in fast-moving environments

   - Is comfortable managing multiple moving parts at once

   - Communicates clearly and professionally

   - Understands the importance of planning ahead and meeting timelines

   - Can handle shoot/event logistics calmly under pressure

   - Understands the importance of maintaining backup talent/options in case of last-minute changes

   - Has strong negotiation and coordination skills

   - Has experience coordinating productions, shoots, events, or campaigns (preferred)



Important Note

This role is operational and coordination-focused.



We are specifically looking for someone who can create structure, organization, and advance planning around physical shoots/events so launches and productions are executed smoothly and proactively rather than reactively.





How To Apply



Please complete the application form to be considered for this role.





Please do not apply directly through OnlineJobs.ph, as we will only review candidates who complete the application form above.



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the next step of the hiring process.

title: Senior Medusa.js Developer
description:
About Us

We are building a next-generation, premium marketplace. We are moving beyond the traditional "Buy It Now" model to create a dynamic trading platform that includes a sophisticated "Make an Offer" negotiation engine, a digital wallet system, and a full-service physical consignment and warehousing operation.



This is not a standard e-commerce build. We are creating a complex, multi-sided marketplace with unique business logic, hybrid payment flows, and physical inventory management. We have chosen Medusa.js as our foundational architecture because we need total headless flexibility, robust custom workflows, and native marketplace capabilities.



The Role



We are seeking a Senior Medusa.js Developer to lead the technical architecture and development of the platform. You will be responsible for building the core custom modules that differentiate our business, integrating with third-party services, and ensuring the platform is scalable, secure, and performant.



You will work closely with the founding team to translate complex business requirements into elegant, maintainable Node.js/TypeScript code.



Key Responsibilities & Custom Modules to Build



1. The Offer Engine (State Machine): Build a robust negotiation system allowing buyers to submit offers, sellers to accept/decline/counter, and manage the complex state transitions and time-expirations of these offers using Medusa's Workflows SDK.



2. Digital Wallet & Hybrid Payments: Implement a user wallet system where users can hold funds from sales. Crucially, you must build a custom checkout flow that allows a single transaction to be split between wallet funds and a credit card (via Stripe Connect).



3. Warehousing & Consignment Module: Develop a custom backend module to manage physical inventory. This includes generating unique barcode IDs for incoming stock, tracking storage locations, and managing the "Hold in" logic (where buyers purchase but delay shipping to consolidate orders).



4. Stripe Connect Integration: Architect the complex payment splitting and automated payouts required for a multi-vendor marketplace, ensuring compliance and seamless onboarding for our consignors.



5. Multi-Channel Sync: Build robust integrations to sync our "Buy It Now" inventory with Google Shopping and eBay, ensuring real-time stock updates across all channels.



Required Skills & Experience



• Deep Medusa.js Expertise: Proven experience building complex, custom e-commerce solutions using Medusa.js (v1 or v2). You must understand its core architecture, plugin system, and Workflows SDK.



• Node.js & TypeScript: Expert-level proficiency in backend JavaScript/TypeScript development.



• Marketplace Architecture: Experience building multi-vendor marketplaces, handling split payments, and managing complex user roles.



• Stripe Connect: Deep understanding of Stripe Connect (Custom or Express accounts) for marketplace routing and payouts.



• API Design: Strong experience designing and consuming RESTful and GraphQL APIs.



• Database Management: Proficiency with PostgreSQL and Redis.



Work Setup



• Flexible hours / outcome-focused delivery: We care about what you build, not when you log on.



• Experienced Team: Work with a team running multiple SaaS brands and an established digital agency.



To Apply



Please submit:



1. Your CV or LinkedIn/GitHub profile.



2. Links to any relevant projects, demos, or code (specifically Medusa.js projects if possible).



3. Your answers to the following application questions.



Application Questions (Required)



If the above sounds like you, please apply. Your application will include the following questions:



1. What interests you most about building a complex, multi-sided marketplace?



2. Describe a previous project where you built a custom e-commerce solution or marketplace using Medusa.js. What was the most complex custom module you had to build, and how did you approach it?



3. We require a hybrid payment system where a user can pay for a $1,000 order using $400 from their digital wallet and $600 via credit card. How would you architect this custom checkout flow within Medusa.js and Stripe?



4. We need a robust "Make an Offer" engine with states like Pending, Accepted, Countered, and Expired. How would you leverage Medusa's Workflows SDK or custom services to build this state machine reliably?



5. If you had to deliver an MVP of this platform in 8–10 weeks, what would you prioritise, what would you defer, and what specific Medusa plugins or starters would you leverage to accelerate development?



6. What is your general availability each week?



7. What excites you most about joining a startup team building something new from the ground up?



8. What is your expected salary expectation?



9. Please also let us know why you are the right person, explain your experience, and tell us why we should hire you.

title: Senior Sylius / Symfony Developer
description:
About Us



We are building an innovative, upcoming online marketplace. We are moving away from traditional auction models to a dual-sales approach: "Buy It Now" and "Make an Offer".



We operate a full-service consignment model where we handle the physical inventory, inspecting, photographing, and storing the goods, while providing a seamless digital experience for both buyers and sellers. Our platform will integrate advanced features like a digital wallet for sale proceeds, hybrid payments, complex shipping logistics (including "Hold in Cellar"), and multi-channel sales via Google Shopping, Amazon Marketplace and eBay.



We are a small, experienced founding team looking for a highly skilled technical partner to build the core platform.



The Role



We are seeking a Senior Sylius / Symfony Developer to architect and build the platform from the ground up. You will be responsible for taking our detailed technical specifications and turning them into a robust, scalable, and secure e-commerce marketplace.



This is not a standard e-commerce build. You will be developing complex custom modules on top of the Sylius framework to handle our unique business logic.



Key Responsibilities



• Platform Architecture: Design and implement the core platform using Sylius and Symfony.

• Custom Module Development: Build sophisticated custom modules, including:



• Offer Engine: A state machine-driven system allowing buyers to submit offers and sellers to accept/reject them.

• Wallet & Hybrid Payments: A digital wallet system for sellers to hold proceeds, integrated with Stripe Connect for complex payouts and hybrid (wallet + card) checkout flows.

• Warehousing & Logistics: A backend module to manage physical inventory, barcode generation, storage locations, and consolidated shipping ("Hold in Cellar").

• Multi-Channel Integrations: Automated feeds for Google Shopping and a comprehensive two-way integration with the eBay API.

• API Development: Design and build RESTful APIs to support a future mobile application.

• Third-Party Integrations: Integrate with Stripe Connect, shipping providers, and potentially external identity/age verification services.

• Quality Assurance: Write comprehensive unit and integration tests to ensure platform stability and security.



Required Skills & Experience



• Deep Sylius Expertise: Proven experience building complex, custom e-commerce platforms using Sylius. You must understand how to extend Sylius core components, state machines, and resource management.

• Symfony Mastery: Strong background in PHP 8+ and the Symfony framework.

• Marketplace Experience: Previous experience building multi-vendor marketplaces or platforms with complex payment splitting (Stripe Connect experience is highly desirable).

• API Design: Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs.

• Database Design: Strong SQL skills and experience with Doctrine ORM.

• Frontend Integration: While this is primarily a backend role, you should be comfortable working with Twig templates and integrating frontend assets.

• Testing: Commitment to automated testing (PHPUnit, Behat).



Work Setup



• Flexible hours: We are outcome-focused. Delivery matters more than specific hours logged.

• Collaboration: You will work directly with the founders and our UX/UI design team.



Application Questions (Required)



If this sounds like the challenge you've been looking for, please apply with your CV/LinkedIn, links to relevant GitHub repositories or live projects, and answers to the following questions:



1. Sylius Experience: Describe the most complex custom module or feature you have built on top of Sylius. What was the business problem, and how did you solve it technically?

2. Marketplace Payments: Have you worked with Stripe Connect or similar complex payment splitting systems? If so, briefly describe the implementation.

3. State Machines: Our "Make an Offer" feature requires a robust state machine (Pending -> Accepted/Rejected/Expired). How would you approach implementing this within the Sylius ecosystem?

4. MVP Delivery: If you had to deliver the core MVP (Buy It Now + Make an Offer + Basic Stripe integration) in 8-10 weeks, what would be your technical approach and what potential bottlenecks would you anticipate?

5. Availability & Rates: What is your general availability each week, and what is your expected salary?

6. What excites you most about joining a startup team building something new from the ground up?



Please also let us know why you are the right person, explain your experience and tell us why we should hire you.

Ancient Remedies is a natural health and wellness brand on a mission to help people help themselves through holistic medicine.



Our products already have strong demand across other channels, and thousands of customers rave about the impact they have had. The opportunity now is to bring that same energy to TikTok Shop.

You will own the strategy, economics, affiliate program, creator relationships, content direction, paid media direction, agency management, and team structure for TikTok Shop. You will have the freedom to bring ideas, test aggressively, hire the right people, and build the operating system needed to turn TikTok Shop into a profitable, creator-led growth engine.

• You understand affiliates, creators, content, offers, commissions, GMV Max, paid media, and unit economics at a deep level. You know how to drive profitable revenue, not just GMV.

• You are strategic, but hands-on. You study what the best TikTok Shop brands are doing. You know what motivates creators to post, what makes content convert, and how to build a system where top affiliates can win big.

• Experience working in the hospitality industry 

• 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar client-facing role

• Proven experience managing enterprise-level SaaS accounts

• Experience working with US-based clients or companies (comfortable with time zone overlap)

• Strong background in SaaS environments, ideally in companies with $25M+ ARR

• Demonstrated ability to lead QBRs and drive customer engagement strategies

• Excellent English communication skills (verbal and written)

• Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail

• Proactive, with a strong sense of ownership and urgency

• Collaborative team player who thrives in fast-paced, remote environments



Why Join Us

• Work directly with a global, high-growth SaaS company

• Competitive compensation aligned with top Philippine market rates

• Remote-first culture with flexible working arrangements

• Opportunities for career growth and exposure to international clients

• Be part of a supportive, respectful, and high-performing team



HOW TO APPLY



Application Link: 



As part of our standard recruitment procedure, we kindly ask that you complete your application through Rippling, our global Human Resources Information System (HRIS). This platform is used globally at DTiQ to ensure a consistent and secure way of managing candidate information.



What to expect:

We understand that this process may be different from traditional application methods commonly used in the Philippines, such as submitting resumes via
 or by job postings. Our HRIS system will require you to:

• Create a profile with a username and password for you to access throughout the recruiting process and if hired, it will be used for timekeeping and payroll.

• Re-enter details already included in your resume (this helps us standardize globally). We recognize this may seem repetitive but it ensures your profile is properly integrated into our global system which is necessary to schedule interviews and onboard.

• Upload supporting documents such as your CV.



Once your profile is complete in Rippling, we’ll begin to schedule interviews with qualified candidates. The interview will last up to an hour and may include 1-2 people (the direct hiring manager and potentially a department lead).



Hired candidates will be engaged through an Employment of Record (EOR) at the start of employment. This is a widely used approach by international companies to hire talent in countries where we do not yet have a legal entity and allows us to comply with legal regulations. This means that Rippling, our EOR provider in the Philippines will officially employ you on behalf of DTiQ Technologies while you will work day-to-day with our team. Under this arrangement salary, government contributions and taxes are processed in compliance with Philippine regulations. DTiQ will manage your daily work, performance and career development. If you have further questions about this arrangement, please let me know and I’d be happy to address it with you.



Is my data secure?

Yes, the system complies with international data privacy standards and your information will only be accessed by authorized personnel.



What if I experience technical issues?

If you have any trouble in the Rippling system, please reply to this message so we can assist you properly.



We truly appreciate your time and effort in completing these next steps. If you have any questions or concerns, please reach out – I’m here to help.



At DTiQ, we value dedication, teamwork, and continuous improvement. If you are looking for a stable job with opportunities to grow and develop your skills, we encourage you to apply and be part of our global team.

mbers to understand how they work

description:
Who We Are



We're one of the fastest-growing travel jewelry brands in the US, and we want you to become part of our editing team, a global team of talent from all over the world. High pay, real creative ownership, no micromanaging.



Most of our editors have been with us for over a year and a half. This is a long-term partnership, not a gig. Our top editors earn $1,000–$2,000+/month, every month.



Exchange Life sells collectible country flag charms, keychains, bracelets, and necklaces for travelers. We run a fully remote team of editors, filmmakers, and creators across time zones, and we treat our people like long-term partners, not freelancers.



What You'll Do



- Edit short-form content that actually performs. TikTok and Reels. Hook, pacing, captions, B-roll, sound design. Fast cuts built to stop the scroll.

- Think in metrics, not just aesthetics. Hook rate, watch time, and retention are your creative compass. You study what's working and apply it to every edit.

- Collaborate on new concepts with the marketing team. Test new angles, iterate on winning formats, and help shape what the brand looks like at scale.

- Ship fast and stay consistent. No hand-holding needed. You communicate clearly, turn around content quickly, and own your work.



You're a Fit If...



- You have at least one TikTok or Reel that crossed 500K views in the last 2 months, and you can explain exactly what made it work

- Your portfolio has 10+ short-form edits from the last 30 days (TikTok or Reels only)

- You think in hook rate, retention, and watch time, not just that something looks “pretty”

- You're highly proficient in CapCut Pro, or any other editing tool you use.

- You deliver fast, communicate clearly in English, and don't need check-ins to stay on track



This Isn't for You If...



- Your portfolio is mostly long-form, YouTube, or wedding/event content

- You can't point to a recent video that went viral and explain why

Compensation



Base rate: 185 PHP /hr, approximately 35 hours a week, with a fully flexible schedule (you work whenever you want as long as you respect deadlines).



Performance bonuses: Uncapped, paid for viral videos and winning ad creatives.



Constant Feedback Loop & Training: You're never left to guess. Our team helps you grow fast and makes sure you're always working on the right things.



This is a long-term role. We invest in people who are committed and want to keep getting better. We'll literally pay you to improve: courses, 1-on-1 mentorship, we want you to become the best at what you do and be part of your journey!
