title: Highly Organized Personal Executive Assistant for Multi-Venture Business Owner
description:
1. Overview & Company Philosophy

We are seeking an exceptionally organized, systematic, and detail-oriented Executive Virtual Assistant to act as a direct personal anchor and operational filter for a multi-venture business owner. 



Please note: You will assist the owner personally in managing their executive responsibilities across two separate companies. You will work directly for the owner, rather than working for or being embedded within either of the corporate entities themselves.



This role is designed to act as a defensive shield between the owner and daily operational chaos, allowing them to shift from a reactive mindset into high-level business execution. If you take extreme pride in system order and structural consistency, we want you to be our partner in building that order. 



2. Core Responsibilities

You will manage three tightly systemized personal workflows for the owner on a daily basis:

a. Weekly Preparation & Cross-Inbox Management: Act as the primary gatekeeper and filter for the owner’s separate corporate mailboxes. Clear out operational noise, flag messages requiring immediate attention, and archive/log administrative items. Curate and prepare the owner's personal master schedule every Friday afternoon, creating a blueprint block map for the upcoming week.

b. Personal Briefing & Meeting Coordination: Coordinate recurring meetings and streamline multi-calendar scheduling native to Outlook. Prior to any major executive engagement, build an organized "Meeting Brief" card inside our personal work hub 24 hours in advance, compiling context, historic files, and priority agendas so the owner is instantly briefed. 

c. Asynchronous Progress Tracking & Project Hub Auditing: Audit and centralize the owner's personal tracking visibility across multiple venture boards using OpenProject. Act as a direct buffer for the owner by monitoring milestone dates, checking boards for data entry holes, and cleanly requesting real-time updates from other tea
mbers inside the platform. Submit a structured Daily Report at the end of every shift answering three questions: 1. What was completed today? 2. What blocks or questions require the owner's feedback? 3. What are the definitive priorities for next shift?



3. Required Profile & Skills

Ideal Personality Profile: You must love building order and following systematic rules.

Technical Literacy: Advanced experience with Microsoft Outlook (specifically multi-account structures, folder logic). Highly comfortable with or capable of instantly navigating project management infrastructure like OpenProject, Asana, or Basecamp.

Communication: Exceptional written English and clear, text-based asynchronous communication. You must be comfortable tracking down task details independently.



4. Expectations & Work Culture

Engagement Type: Part-time (3 hours per week). 

Culture Fit: Guided by classical principles of stewardship, progress, and systematic order. We value careful execution and clear ownership over your work. Mistakes are never fixed *for* you; instead, the owner will point out errors so you can systematically correct them yourself to master the process.



5. How to Apply (Please Read Carefully)

We are looking for someone who pays extreme attention to detail and can follow systematic rules. To ensure that you have read this entire job post and understand the role, you must use the exact phrase "I love building systematic order" as the subject line of your application.



In your message, please include a brief 2-3 sentence introduction detailing your experience with Outlook Delegate Access and Project Management tools. Applications that do not follow these exact instructions will be automatically ignored.

title: Manager, Affiliate (Channel) Sales Analyst
description:
Truegenics is a leading eCommerce company with a proven track record of over US$218M in online product sales. Our affiliate program has been a long-standing and critical driver of our success in the U.S. market.



We are hiring a Manager to join our Affiliate Channel Sales team. This role is ideal for someone with strong analytical ability, business acumen, and commercial judgement, who can manage affiliate partnerships and drive measurable revenue growth. 



The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying performance opportunities, improving partner productivity, supporting affiliate recruitment and activation, and translating data into clear business actions that drive revenue, margin, and long-term partner value.



This role works normal office hours, with occasional evening calls to support U.S.-based partners or business needs.



Key Responsibilities



Commercial Analysis & Business Performance

- Own the weekly performance narrative: surface trends, gaps, wins, risks, and clear next steps.

- Analyse affiliate performance across revenue, margin, EPC, AOV, conversion rate, funnel performance, traffic quality, and partner productivity to identify what’s driving or limiting growth.

- Use data & AI to support decisions on partner prioritisation, campaign strategy, offer testing, commission structures, and promotional planning and own the follow-through on those recommendations.

- Identify growth opportunities, underperforming areas, and commercial risks, then recommend clear actions to improve business outcomes.



Affiliate Growth & Partner Activation

- Identify, pitch, and onboard new affiliate partners through
, messaging platforms, calls, and other digital communication channels.

- Ensure new partners are activated quickly, understand campaign requirements, and have the tools needed to start driving results.

- Maintain consistent, structured follow-up with prospective and newly onboarded partners, with a clear pipeline and conversion cadence.



Account Management & Partner Optimization

- Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for a portfolio of affiliate partners, with clear ownership of partner revenue performance.

- Build strong working relationships through responsive communication, structured follow-up, and commercially sound recommendations.

- Resolve partner blockers and help optimize campaigns to improve revenue, margin, conversion performance, and partner engagement.

- Identify high-potential partners and develop plans to scale their contribution.



Campaign Execution & Compliance

- Coordinate launches, bonuses, contests, seasonal promotions, creative updates, funnel tests, and partner-specific offers with internal teams.

- Work closely with Creative, Supply Chain, IT, and other stakeholders to ensure campaigns are executed on time and aligned with business goals.

- Monitor partner activity, promotional methods, messaging, and traffic quality to ensure compliance with affiliate guidelines, terms and conditions, and brand standards.

- Escalate suspicious activity, compliance risks, or poor-quality traffic when needed.



Cross-Functional Collaboration & Process Improvement

- Share market, competitor, and partner feedback with internal teams to improve offers, messaging, creative assets, funnels, and partner tools.

- Contribute to process improvements, including the use of AI and automation, to make the affiliate program more scalable, efficient, and commercially effective.





Key Skills & Experience

- 5 to 8 years of experience in sales, affiliate marketing, channel sales, partnerships, digital marketing, or eCommerce growth, with at least 2 to 3 years of experience managing affiliate, channel partner, partnership, or performance-based sales programs.

- Background in personal care, health, wellness, supplements, pharmaceutical, or direct-response eCommerce industries is a plus.

- Strong analytical skills and business acumen, with the ability to interpret performance data and translate insights into practical business actions.

- Clear understanding of revenue, margin, conversion, AOV, EPC, ROI, and commercial trade-offs.

- Proven track record of driving revenue growth through affiliates, partners, online sales channels, or performance marketing initiatives.

- Solid understanding of online sales, digital marketing funnels, affiliate networks, partner marketing, or performance-based acquisition.

- Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills, including pivot tables, lookups, trend analysis, and performance reporting.

- Comfortable using AI tools and automation to improve business analysis, reporting, partner management, campaign execution, or operational efficiency. Candidates should be able to share practical use cases. Willingness to use AI and automation is a requirement for this role.

- Comfortable communicating with prospects and partners through
, messaging platforms, and occasional calls, with strong written communication skills for outreach, follow-ups, campaign updates, and commercial recommendations. 

- Able to manage multiple partners, campaigns, and priorities independently.



Other Notes:

The candidate should be comfortable working with U.S.-based partners and joining occasional evening calls as and when needed, estimated at least once per month. There may also be occasional travel to the U.S. or other locations for networking conferences or business needs, approximately 2–3 times per year, if required. 



What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is commercially sharp, analytical, and proactive. The right candidate should be able to look at affiliate performance, understand what is driving or limiting growth, and recommend practical actions that improve results.



This person does not need to be primarily a face-to-face salesperson. However, they should be comfortable engaging prospects and partners through written communication, messaging,
, and occasional calls.



The ideal candidate is someone who can balance numbers, partner relationships, execution, and business judgment.



Working Arrangement:

title: Fractional Growth / GTM Lead
description:
The Company



Hire Anywhere connects UK small businesses with vetted, full-time overseas talent through a proper headhunting model — not a gig marketplace. We give founders the Fortune 500 international hiring playbook, run for them by a Head of Talent in Manila who has built teams for global organisations.



We're a small founder-led business and ready to build the demand side properly.



The Problem We're Hiring You to Fix



We have no demand engine. Nobody is doing outbound. The product works and the supply side is solid — there is simply no pipeline, because there has never been anyone whose job is to build one.



This role is not about managing isolated marketing channels. It’s about helping us build a repeatable pipeline and creating qualified conversations with founders who are exploring overseas hiring for the first time.



A large part of the challenge is trust and positioning. Business owners are often interested in overseas hiring, but uncertain whether the quality, communication, and cultural fit will actually work in practice.



That’s the role.



What You'll Own



You own the demand engine end to end:



- Building the target account list against our ICP

- Setting up the outbound infrastructure — sending tooling, LinkedIn presence, simple landing pages, booking flow

- Writing and running multi-channel outbound sequences 
-led, LinkedIn alongside, selective calling)

- Managing inbound replies and getting qualified discovery calls into the founder's calendar

- Refining messaging and positioning based on market feedback and response data

- Reporting pipeline and outreach metrics weekly



The founder owns the ICP definition, discovery calls, recruitment delivery, and pricing — and review messaging before it goes out. Everything else on the demand side is yours.



Who We're Looking For

- You have personally built B2B outbound or pipeline generation from zero — not managed a team that did, built it yourself

- Experience with a high-ticket, considered-purchase service sold via conversations (recruitment, staffing, professional services, agencies, or high-touch B2B SaaS are closest)

- You think commercially and strategically, but operate hands-on

- You’re comfortable owning the full demand generation process rather than specialising in a single channel

- Genuinely hands-on: you'll build the list, write the sequences, set up the tooling and send the outreach yourself

- Self-directing: you take “here’s the ICP and the narrative, go” and come back with a built system and live outreach

- Comfortable owning numbers and being held accountable to pipeline outcomes



Probably not a fit:

- pure paid-media backgrounds

- pure SEO/content backgrounds

- social-media-only marketers

- strategists or advisors who direct rather than execute

- anyone who needs a team or large budget to function

- Target customer (so you can picture the work)



Small, founder-led UK businesses — solo up to ~30 people — in media, marketing/creative agencies, business advisory, or e-commerce.



The founder is the buyer and the budget. They're buried in delegatable work while growth stalls, and they've usually either been burned by a talent marketplace or never knew real overseas hiring was an option for a business their size.



Work Set Up

- Rolling monthly contract, roughly 2–3 days per week, UK hours

- Clear 60–90 day expectation: target list built, outbound infrastructure live, and a consistent flow of qualified discovery calls being booked

- Reports directly to the founders; weekly pipeline review

Python Script Optimization: Reviewing, modularizing, and optimizing existing Python scripts. This includes adding structured logging, implementing clean error-handling blocks, and managing API payloads.



N8N Workflow Orchestration: Building and organizing workflows within N8N to automate backend tasks. You will manage and refactor API calls, handle webhooks, and map data across platforms.



Asynchronous Collaboration: Reviewing video walkthroughs (such as Loom screen recordings) detailing project specifications, asking clarifying questions, and independently delivering optimized code.



REQUIRED SKILLS & TECHNICAL STACK



Database Management: Strong proficiency in T-SQL / MS SQL Server. You must understand query optimization, indexing, explicit joins, and database security best practices.



Programming Languages: Proficiency in Python for backend scripting, data manipulation, and working with REST APIs (using libraries such as requests, json, pandas, etc.).



Automation Workflow Tools: Direct, practical experience utilizing N8N (or closely related node-based automation platforms like Make or Zapier) to build and troubleshoot API integrations.



Quality Assurance Mindset: Strong code optimization skills. You should naturally write self-documenting code with clear variable naming, modular structures, and comprehensive error handling.



Communication: Exceptional written English. Because this role is asynchronous, you must be comfortable tracking down task details independently and articulating technical concepts clearly via text or video.



WORK SCHEDULE, EXPECTATIONS, & CULTURE



Weekly Hours: 5 to 10 hours per week.



Flexible Schedule: You can work your own hours during the day or night. We value output and code quality over the exact time on the clock.



No Micromanagement: We do not use invasive, screenshot-taking time-trackers. Instead, we gauge your value based on the elegance, readability, and reliability of your code.



Daily Reports: To keep tasks moving smoothly, we require a quick, simple end-of-day
 report answering three questions (even if you worked 0 hours that day):

What did you work on/complete today?

What roadblocks or issues did you encounter?

What are your next steps?



Culture of Ownership: We encourage an environment of high accountability and low fear. We expect you to speak up if our prototype logic is flawed. Your job is to point out mistakes, suggest better architectural patterns, and systematically take ownership of the code quality.



COMPENSATION & TRUST-BUILDING TERMS



Hourly Rate: Competitive hourly rate based on technical experience and depth of skills. Let us know your expected hourly rate in your application.



Weekly Payments: To build mutual trust and assure you that we are a legitimate, reliable partner, we will establish weekly payments for your first two months of employment, transitioning to bi-weekly or monthly payments afterward based on your preference.



Growth Opportunity: While this role begins at 5–10 hours per week, there is a clear opportunity for your hours and responsibilities to scale as our systems grow and your integration with our workflows deepens.



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)



Because code quality, precision, and attention to detail are critical to this role, we use a strict screening process to filter out generic, copy-paste applications.



To apply, please reply via
 with the following exact subject line:

???? "I love clean SQL and Python workflows! Ready to optimize your systems."



In your application message, please answer these three questions:



N8N Experience: What is your experience level with N8N? Provide a brief description of a complex workflow or API integration you have successfully automated using N8N.



SQL Optimization: In your own words, what are the first three things you check when a client hands you a slow-running SQL query that is dragging down dashboard performance?



Refactoring Workflow: Tell me about a time you had to take over someone else’s unpolished code or quick prototype. What did you prioritize to turn it into production-ready software?



Please note: Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a short, paid test task (under 1 hour) to demonstrate SQL optimization and scripting standards.

title: Part-Time Bookkeeper (E-Commerce | Amazon Experience Required)
description:
Part-Time Bookkeeper (E-Commerce | US Pet Supply Company) - Amazon Experience Required



Contractor Role | 16–20 Hours/Month | EST Overlap Required  



About the Role  

We’re looking for a detail-oriented, e-commerce–savvy Bookkeeper to join our US-based pet supply company. This is a part-time, independent contractor role  (approx. 4 hours/week) with flexible scheduling and a required overlap with US EST business hours. You’ll be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, tracking inventory, and supporting our e-commerce operations across multiple platforms. You’ll work closely with company leadership and periodically present financial insights to C-level stakeholders.



If you’re an experienced bookkeeper who thrives in a fast-paced environment and wants a long-term partnership, this could be the perfect fit.



What’s in It for You?

- Competitive pay (based on experience)

- Flexible hours with partial EST overlap

- Remote work — from the comfort of your home

- Long-term opportunity with room to grow



Be part of an exciting, people-first company in the pet supply niche!



About Us

We are a US-based e-commerce business specializing in pet supplies and dog training products.  As we grow, we’re seeking a reliable bookkeeper who understands both US accounting practices  and the unique needs of e-commerce bookkeeping, with specific focus on Amazon Seller Central.  



Responsibilities

- Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records

- Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and payment processors (PayPal, Stripe, etc.)

- Perform month-end closing and prepare financial reports

- Track sales, returns, refunds, and fees across e-commerce platforms (e.g., Shopify, Amazon, Walmart, etc)

- Ensure accurate recording of inventory, COGS, and related adjustments

- Support compliance with GAAP standards and tax-related documentation

- Prepare and present financial summaries and insights to C-level stakeholders as needed

- Participate in periodic meetings with company leadership to review financial performance and answer questions



Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (Required)

- 3–5 years of bookkeeping experience (supporting US-based e-commerce companies or accounting firms)

- Amazon Seller Central experience strongly required

- Knowledge of SellerBoard required

- Proficiency with QuickBooks or Xero, plus Google Workspace/Microsoft Office  

- Experience with e-commerce platforms and marketplace accounting

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy in financial data

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

- Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and adapt in a dynamic environment

- Experience communicating and presenting financial reports or insights to senior leadership or executive teams



Requirements

- Personal computer and reliable high-speed internet

- Quiet, distraction-free workspace

- Ability to work part-time with consistent EST overlap hours



Ideal Candidate Profile

- Organized & Detail-Oriented  – You spot errors before anyone else does.

- Process-Oriented  – You create efficient workflows and stick to them.

- Client-Service Mindset  – You’re proactive, responsive, and reliable.

- Adaptable & Tech-Savvy  – You embrace new tools and learn quickly.

- Passionate Learner  – You enjoy growing your skills and staying current in e-commerce trends.

- Executive-Ready Communicator – You can confidently explain financials, trends, and recommendations to C-level leaders in a clear, professional way.



If this sounds like a good fit for you, please send a copy or link to your resume and a short cover letter highlighting your e-commerce bookkeeping experience.

title: Experienced Customer service/Inside Sales
description:
“We love to break $%*&!”



That's our motto at Big Hammer—we help customers tackle their demolition projects by providing quality tools and products. Our Shopify store is growing, and we're looking for a proactive, detail-oriented tea
mber to join our team and support our rapid expansion!



Our Shopify store is growing fast and we’re hiring an EXPERIENCED B2B Inside Sales Virtual Assistant to own inbound leads (phone +
), run quotes, follow up like a professional, and build real customer relationships.



WORKING HOURS:



• Standard US business hours

• Main shift: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST

• Onboarding hours may vary slightly depending on what works best for you and us



WHAT YOU’LL DO (KEY RESPONSIBILITIES):



1. Inside Sales/Customer service (Primary)



• Answer inbound calls/emails/messages and convert inquiries into quotes/orders

• Sell in a B2B relationship world: repair shops, rental fleets, dealers, municipal purchasing—repeat customers and professional persistence

• Ask the right questions to confirm fitment (model, serial/variant info when relevant, part #, photos, measurements when needed)

• Prepare and send quotes using our templates/process

• Follow up consistently until the deal is closed or clearly dead (no dropped leads)

• Handle common B2B workflows: written quotes, purchase orders (POs), lead time questions, “send me a quote for purchasing,” etc.

• Communicate in a practical, direct, customer-friendly way (not corporate fluff)



2. CRM + Pipeline Discipline



• Keep CRM notes clean and complete (what they need, what we quoted, what’s missing, next step)

• Keep pipeline stages accurate and set follow-up tasks/reminders

• Capture lead source details when available (we care about attribution)



3. E-commerce Support (Secondary)



• Upload/update/edit product listings on Shopify (as assigned)

• Help with order processing and customer updates when needed

• Review drawings/product images for accurate part numbers/product details (accuracy matters)



4. General VA Support (As needed)



• Data entry and organization (Google Sheets/Excel; Notion if used)

• Light image edits in Canva (nice to have)

• Online research and assistant support that helps sales/ops



REQUIREMENTS (PLEASE DON’T APPLY IF YOU DON’T MEET THESE):



• 3+ years inside sales experience (required).

• Strong English (spoken + written) and confident phone presence

• Proven follow-up discipline (you can explain your cadence/system)

• CRM experience required (HubSpot preferred)

• Shopify experience

• Detail-oriented

• Strong working knowledge of AI tools (ChatGPT or similar) for example: call summaries, follow-ups, quote notes—while verifying facts

• Reliable internet, good headset, quiet workspace



BONUS POINTS:



• Experience selling technical products/parts (heavy equipment parts, industrial supplies, auto parts, machinery, hydraulics)

• Experience working with purchasing departments/PO workflows

• HubSpot power user (pipelines, tasks, sequences)

• Shopify experience (product updates + order workflow)



WHY JOIN BIG HAMMER?



• Positive team environment: We prioritize open communication, respect, and continuous support to ensure your success.

• Growth Opportunities: As we grow, you'll have the opportunity to expand your role and develop professionally. Lots of growth potential.

• Bonus program to reward performance



HOW TO APPLY (IMPORTANT):

Please use the form link below to apply.

** All applications sent through the OnlineJobs portal/messaging will be ignored. **

description:
Pex Life Records LLC is an independent record label dedicated to producing high-quality urban music focused on health, personal relationships, financial literacy, peak performance, bodybuilding, meditation, and spirituality. Founded by Wilmarck, our music merges influences from Kanye West and Drake with motivational themes inspired by Tony Robbins. With over 1,000
 subscribers and 20,000
 followers, we aim to inspire and uplift through our music.



Position: Music Manager



We are looking for a music manager responsible for:

- Pitching proposals to songwriting job boards

- Keeping our books and managing contracts

- Driving success by boosting profits and hitting sales targets

- Leading and inspiring the team to deliver stellar performance

- Recruiting, hiring, and guiding contractors

- Managing operations, scheduling, and compliance

- Creating memorable customer experiences

- Onboarding and training new hires

- Communicating seamlessly with stakeholders

- Working 45-50 hours/week, including evenings, weekends, and holidays

- Lifting up to 25 pounds when needed



Disclaimer: Prospects will respond outside of scheduled hours. There will be an established 8-hour window where you’ll be expected to respond within an hour. Ex. Your schedule hours will be 6:30 PM -3:00 AM EST (From 3-11 PM EST if a prospect responds to a proposal, you’ll be expected to respond. Each response should take 5-15 mins. You can expect 3-5 responses per week. The additional hours may be deducted from your regular schedule if it exceeds 50 hours.



Contract Details

- Hourly Rate: $2.81/hr USD + 10%-15% of revenue

- Monthly Compensation: $505-$900 + commission

- Initial Hours: 10 hours/week, increasing to 45 hours/week over 45 days

- Training: Paid training provided

- Raises: Based on work performance



Hiring Process

This is an audition-based hiring process. We will select 3-5 candidates for a paid audition. After reviewing your work, we'll choose one full-time hire.

- Interview: To assess mutual fit

- Notification: Candidates will be contacted within 48 hours regarding audition status

- Video Chat: For day 1 of the audition



Responsibilities

Immediate Focus:

- Pitching to Songwriting Job Boards

- Album Launch Tasks

- Bookkeeping

- Onboarding & Interviewing Staff

- Explaining service and product prices

- Answering customer inquiries

- Obtaining customer information for shipping/services

- Managing our production team

- Communicating with team members/leaders

- Hitting monthly revenue goals



Future Responsibilities (If Qualified):

- Leading meetings

- Managing teams

- Reporting analytics

- Servicing customers



Skills and Qualifications

Essential:

- Persistence and determination

- Proposal writing skills

- Time management

- Product knowledge

- Customer service proficiency

- Strong English speaking/writing skills

- Reliable internet connection



Ideal Candidate Qualities

- Flexible and eager to learn

- High integrity and commitment

- Relentless execution

- Ability to work independently

- Competitive spirit

- Receptive to constructive criticism

- Effective communication skills



Benefits

 

Music Manager Incentive Program

The program motivates music managers to achieve monthly revenue goals, fostering a productive environment.



Eligibility: Current management team as of Jan 12, 2025

New hires must be with Pex Life Records for 6 months to qualify

Monthly Revenue Goals and Benefits:

- At $1,200 Minimum:

  - Guaranteed Pay: $675 Minimum

  - Commission: 10% on qualifying sales

  - Additional Benefits: 13th Month Pay, Internet Costs Reimbursement, Profit Sharing, PhilHealth Reimbursement



- At $2,400 Minimum:

  - Guaranteed Pay: $900 Minimum

  - Commission: 15% on qualifying sales

  - Additional Benefits: Social Security System Reimbursement, Pag-IBIG Fund Reimbursement, 50% HMO Expenses, Profit                    Sharing

- Contractual Availability

- Flexible Scheduling: Choose your working days/hours

- Job Sharing: Train others to complete your tasks

- Revenue Lock-In Structure

- Contractual lock-in for pay based on hitting revenue goals over 2-12 months.

- Compensation

Monthly Salary: $505 USD (ifgoal isn't attained)

Start Date: 2 weeks after the interview (if selected)

Long-term Position: 32-40 hours/week

Available Hours: Sunday-Thursday 6:30 PM EST - 3:00 AM EST

Work Location: Remote



Only one position is available; apply now!



Application Instructions

In your proposal, please start with "purple elephant" to confirm you've read this job description. Include components of sales management such as writing proposals to acquire clients, appointment setting, and performing introductory calls to close clients. If we'd like to move forward, we'll send you a screening exercise followed by an interview invite if you pass.

title: Sales Manager
description:
Pex Life Records LLC: Our Vision for Transformative Music



Pex Life Records is an independent label where urban music meets personal development. Founded by Wilmarck, we create high-quality tracks that resonate with the motivation of Tony Robbins, blended with the commercial sound of artists like Kanye West and Drake. Our music is purpose-driven, focusing on critical life areas: health, financial literacy, peak performance, and spirituality.



You will be joining a brand with a strong, engaged audience of over 1,000
 subscribers and 20,000
 followers. Your work will directly contribute to inspiring and uplifting thousands through music.-----The Role: Drive Revenue, Build a Team, Shape a Brand



We are seeking a highly motivated Music Manager to lead our sales, operations, and team development. This is a pivotal role for a professional ready to commit to a 45-50 hour/week position that offers substantial commission potential and a clear path to high earnings.



Key Areas of Impact:

Sales & Business Development: Lead client acquisition by pitching proposals to songwriting job boards and driving profits to achieve ambitious sales targets.

Team Leadership: Recruit, hire, train, and inspire contractors and staff to ensure stellar performance and successful new releases.

Operations & Finance: Manage contracts, maintain essential financial records (bookkeeping), and ensure compliance and seamless communication across all stakeholders.

Customer Experience: Be the face of the company, creating memorable customer experiences, explaining product/service prices, and handling key inquiries.



Compensation & Uncapped Earning Potential



This is a performance-driven role with a clear path to significant monthly income through our incentive program.

Base & Growth: The hourly rate starts at $2.81 USD plus commission. The initial 10 hours/week commitment quickly scales up to 45 hours/week within 45 days, allowing for a rapid increase in base earnings.

Monthly Compensation Range: $505–$900 Guaranteed Base + Generous Commission.



Compensation Structure by Target Revenue Goal:

Achieve $1,200 Minimum: Guaranteed Monthly Base: $675 Minimum. Commission Rate: 10% on qualifying sales. Enhanced Benefits Package: 13th Month Pay, Internet Costs Reimbursement, Profit Sharing, PhilHealth Reimbursement.

Achieve $2,400 Minimum: Guaranteed Monthly Base: $900 Minimum. Commission Rate: 15% on qualifying sales. Enhanced Benefits Package: Social Security System & Pag-IBIG Fund Reimbursement, 50% HMO Expenses, Profit Sharing.



Flexibility and Structure:



100% Remote Position: Work from anywhere.

Core Availability: Sunday–Thursday, 6:30 PM EST – 3:00 AM EST.

Work/Life Balance: We offer Flexible Scheduling (choose your working days/hours) and Job Sharing options.

Prospect Response Disclaimer: Maintain key client relationships by being available for 3-5 quick, 5–15 minute responses per week within a designated 8-hour window (e.g., 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM EST).



What We're Looking For (Skills & Qualities)



We need a relentless executor with an independent spirit and high integrity.

Essential: Superior proposal writing, persistence, time management, and strong English speaking/writing skills.

Ideal Candidate: Flexible, eager to learn, competitive, and receptive to constructive criticism.



Your Path to Full-Time: The Paid Audition



We skip the traditional hiring steps and go straight to evaluating your work. The process is designed to be fair, fast, and merit-based:

1 Submit your proposal.

2 Pass a screening exercise.

3 Participate in an interview.

4 Top candidates are selected for a paid audition to ensure a mutual fit before a full-time offer is extended.

If you are ready to be a crucial leader in a high-growth, mission-driven music company, apply now!



Application Instructions:



Demonstrate your expertise in sales management (client acquisition, appointment setting, and closing calls) in your proposal. To ensure you've read these details, please begin your proposal with the phrase "purple elephant."

title: Amazon Brand/Listing Manager
description:
Listing Creation & Optimization

Create new product listings from scratch (titles, bullets, descriptions, backend keywords)

Optimize existing listings for Amazon's Rufus AI and Cosmo algorithm conversational queries, attribute coverage, and semantic relevance

Write SEO-rich copy that converts not just keyword-stuffed filler

Keep listings updated with seasonal or promotional changes



Listing Management Cases & Suppressions

Monitor the account health dashboard and act on suppressed or stranded ASINs proactively

Open and follow up on Seller Central cases until resolved suppressions, policy warnings, lost buy box, flat file errors, etc.

Escalate complex issues and document resolution steps for future reference



AI-Assisted Image & Creative Support

Use AI image generation tools (e.g., Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, or similar) to create or enhance product imagery and infographics

Produce lifestyle images, comparison charts, and A+ content visuals that match brand guidelines

Work with design guidelines to maintain a consistent visual identity across the catalog



General Amazon Operations

Monitor inventory levels and flag restock needs

Track competitor pricing and flag significant changes

Submit and manage promotional deals (coupons, lightning deals, Prime discounts)

Maintain organized records of all campaign data, case numbers, and listing changes



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Must-Haves

Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience managing an Amazon Seller Central account

Experience resolving listing suppressions and opening Seller Central cases

Comfortable creating listings using flat files or the Seller Central interface

Working knowledge of Amazon's Rufus AI search and Cosmo relevance optimization

Experience using AI tools for image generation and creative enhancement

Strong written English clear, professional communication

Reliable internet connection, able to meet deadlines independently



Nice-to-Haves

Experience in the sports, fitness, or athleisure product category

Familiar with Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or DataDive for keyword research and listing optimization

Experience with A+ Content and Amazon Brand Registry

Basic knowledge of Amazon Brand Analytics and search term reports



HOW TO APPLY

We review every application carefully. To stand out, please include ALL of the following in your application:

Brief introduction who you are and how long you have been doing Amazon VA work.

Your expected monthly or hourly rate be specific. We will not follow up with applications that do not include a rate.

Summary of your Amazon experience what categories you have worked in, account sizes managed (approximate monthly revenue), and key wins.

Tools you use list the tools and AI platforms you work with regularly (e.g., Helium 10, Midjourney, DataDive, etc.).

Sample work a listing you wrote or an AI image you created. Even a link or screenshot is fine.

Availability your weekly availability and how many other clients you currently work with.



To confirm you read this posting carefully, please start your application message with the phrase: "I know Amazon."



WHAT WE OFFER

Stable, long-term engagement we are not looking for project-based help

Direct communication with the store owner no middlemen or agencies

Room to grow as the brand expands into new products and markets

Flexible schedule as long as deliverables are met on time

A collaborative, no-micromanaging working relationship built on results



We look forward to reading your application.

Only applicants who follow the instructions above will be reviewed.

title: Medical Coding Quality Analyst
description:
Quality Analyst is responsible to perform activities outlined in the Service Quality Plan and identify auditor / program level improvement opportunities. QA Analyst is required to work closely with the production resources to ensure adherence to the client and process specific requirements. Ensure that regular feedback and error sharing sessions are conducted to avoid repetition of errors and help improve overall performance. Other activities of the quality analyst include – reporting, calibrations, process analysis and attending client and internal meetings.



Responsibilities:



• Responsible for quality monitoring on claims/cases/transactions and/or telephonic interactions



• Conduct Process training as and when required



• Provide feedback to auditors/clinical team members using prescribed feedback model



• Mentoring and coaching auditors on process level issues.



• Monitor adherence to compliance procedures and processes.



• Responsible for reporting program level quality score to the process owners.



• Responsible for conducting calibration and performance review call in terms of quality with the internal team. (Initially will be assisting the senior quality analyst, training and guidance will be provided to be able to lead such meetings in future).



• Conduct refresher training on the basis of the errors identified.



• Communicate process updates by conducting a session as and when required.



• Maintaining update log and sharing it with the team on a regular basis.



• Perform brainstorming and root cause analysis to analyse data and provide tips or suggestions to operations/management team.



• Identify and highlight potential risk areas and recommend preventive action.





RELEVANT EXPERIENCE & EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS:



• Registered Nurse with CPC/COC certification



• Minimum one year experience working as Team Leader or equivalent



• Experience in US Healthcare, medical coding, medical billing, RCM health plan



operations strongly preferred



• Possesses knowledge of healthcare claims payment policy and processing –



• specifically, CMS, Medicaid regulations, AAOS, ICD-9, CPT & HCPCS, etc.



• Practical clinical experience working in a hospital/office or nursing home



• Has general knowledge of medical procedures, conditions, illnesses, and treatment



practices



• Possesses excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to think logically



• and process sequentially with a high level of detailed accuracy and efficiency



• Has excellent personal computer skills in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint,



Outlook, etc.



• Experience working as a Quality Analyst will be an added advantage



• College degree mandatory



• Must be willing to work onsite

title: Experienced SEO Specialist / Experienced SEO Specialist / VA for Shopify E-Commerce Brand
description:
We are a fast-growing US-based e-commerce brand looking for a highly experienced SEO Specialist / VA who can take ownership of organic growth.



This is not an entry-level role. We are not looking for someone who only knows basic keyword research, AI content posting, or simple blog writing. We need someone with real, proven SEO experience who has already helped e-commerce or Shopify brands grow organic traffic, improve rankings, and generate visibility through both search engines and online communities.



We need a person who can come in, analyze what needs to be done, create a plan, execute it, and bring results — without waiting for step-by-step instructions from us.



What You’ll Do



You will be responsible for SEO strategy and execution, including:



Building and managing a complete SEO strategy for our Shopify store

Auditing current pages and identifying ranking opportunities

Optimizing product pages, collection pages, blog posts, and site structure

Performing advanced keyword research based on search intent, competition, and commercial value

Writing, editing, and optimizing SEO articles that are designed to rank

Creating content plans that support traffic, authority, and conversions

Improving internal linking, topical authority, and content clusters

Driving organic brand exposure through Reddit, forums, niche communities, and other white-hat channels

Finding new opportunities for backlinks, mentions, community traffic, and brand visibility

Monitoring rankings, traffic, indexing, and performance

Reporting clearly on what was done, what improved, and what the next steps are



Mandatory Requirements



Please read this carefully before applying.



We only want applicants with serious previous SEO experience. You must be able to show actual work, examples, and results.



You must have:



Proven SEO experience with Shopify, e-commerce, or DTC brands

A strong portfolio of websites, articles, or SEO projects you have worked on

Hands-on experience with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Google Search Console, and Google Analytics

Demonstrable results, such as ranking improvements, traffic growth, indexed content, or successful SEO campaigns

Strong knowledge of on-page SEO, content SEO, search intent, internal linking, and site structure

Experience creating SEO articles that rank, not just generic blog posts

Experience using Reddit, forums, and online communities for brand exposure and organic traffic

Ability to work independently, identify problems, propose solutions, and execute without constant supervision

Strong understanding of white-hat SEO practices

Good reporting skills and the ability to explain what you are doing and why

Please Do Not Apply If

You are new to SEO

You only have basic keyword research experience

You have never worked on Shopify or e-commerce SEO

You cannot show previous SEO projects or results

You need constant instructions for every task

You only rely on AI-generated content without strategy

You are looking to “learn on the job”

You cannot explain how your work will improve rankings, traffic, or visibility



Nice to Have



Experience with US or UK e-commerce markets

DTC brand experience

Basic technical SEO knowledge, including indexing, site speed, schema, crawlability, and Google Search Console

Experience with link-building, digital PR, HARO-style outreach, or brand mentions



The Offer

Fully remote position

Part-time: 3–4 hours per day

$400–$600/month, based on experience

Long-term collaboration for the right person

Clear KPIs and ownership

Opportunity to grow with a fast-moving e-commerce brand



How to Apply



 
 with the following:



A short video introduction

A summary of your SEO experience with Shopify, e-commerce, or DTC brands

A list of SEO tools you have used, including Ahrefs, SEMrush, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, or similar tools

Examples of websites, articles, or SEO projects you have worked on

Proof of results, such as ranking improvements, traffic growth, screenshots, case studies, or campaign examples

A short explanation of what SEO opportunities you would look for first in an e-commerce brand

Tools you use for SEO research, tracking, and reporting



Applications without real examples or proof of previous SEO work will not be considered.

We produce high-quality video ads for agencies, SaaS companies, and service businesses. Our clients trust us because our creative doesn't look like the generic stuff everyone else is running — it looks like it was made by people who actually understand filmmaking.

We're growing fast and we need someone who can take detailed SOPs and execute them flawlessly — whether that's assembling personalized videos, managing social media distribution, running outreach workflows, or handling new processes we build next week. The tasks will change and evolve. What won't change is the standard: follow the SOP, hit the quality bar, deliver on time.



What You'll Be Doing

This is not a traditional VA role. You won't be answering
s or booking appointments. You'll be executing detailed SOPs across video production, social media, and outreach — and as we grow, new SOPs will be added. You need to be the kind of person who can pick up a new process doc, learn it fast, and run it at a high level without hand-holding.

Here are examples of the types of tasks you'll be handling (this list will grow):

Video Assembly & Personalization



Combining video clips with overlay transitions

Swapping screen recordings behind a talking head to personalize pre-recorded videos for specific prospects

Green screen keying (removing green screen backgrounds and replacing with custom content)

Screenshotting prospects' websites, social profiles, and ad libraries

Recording your own screen shares that get edited into final videos

Generating short AI videos using tools like Higgsfield (we'll train you)

Matching screen recordings to exact timing cues from pre-recorded audio



Social Media Posting & Outreach



Posting videos on Instagram, LinkedIn, and
/X

Tagging prospects and adding collaborators on Instagram Reels

Sending personalized DMs using provided templates

Filling in copy templates with prospect-specific details

Managing content distribution across multiple platforms



Research & Prep



Pulling prospect info from
 Ad Library, websites, and social profiles

Building clean Google Docs and presentation materials for prospects

Preparing scripts and creative assets based on provided prompts



Project Management



Pulling tasks and prospect info from ClickUp

Updating task statuses after each deliverable is completed

Keeping everything organized, named correctly, and documented



Whatever Comes Next



New SOPs will be added regularly as the business scales. If you're the type who gets nervous when the routine changes, this isn't for you. If you're the type who gets bored doing the same thing forever and likes learning new workflows, you'll thrive.





What We're Looking For

Must-haves:



Experience with video editing software (CapCut, Premiere, DaVinci Resolve, or similar) — you don't need to be a pro editor, but you need to know how to cut clips together, do basic green screen keying, and export properly

Screen recording experience (Loom, OBS, or similar)

Comfortable navigating social media platforms (Instagram, LinkedIn,
/X) and posting content

Strong attention to detail — timing, naming conventions, tagging the right people, spelling names correctly

Reliable internet connection and a computer that can handle basic video editing

Fluent English (written — you won't be on calls often, but your screen recordings need to look professional)

Ability to follow SOPs precisely without cutting corners



Nice-to-haves:



Experience with ClickUp or similar project management tools

Experience with AI video generation tools (Higgsfield, Runway, etc.)

Familiarity with
 Ad Library

Experience working in a marketing agency or with direct response advertising

Experience with Google Workspace (Docs, Drive)

Familiarity with Gamma (gamma.app)





What Makes Someone Great at This Role

The #1 skill we're hiring for is SOP execution — the ability to read a detailed process document and follow it precisely, at speed, without cutting corners or needing to be reminded.

The tasks themselves aren't hard. Green screen keying isn't brain surgery. Posting a Reel isn't complex. What's hard is doing it perfectly across 15 prospects in a row, every single time, without the quality dropping on prospect #12 because you're tired.

You should be:



Process-driven — you like checklists and systems, not winging it

Detail-obsessed — you notice when something is 2 seconds too long or a name is misspelled

Self-managing — once trained, you can batch a full day's work without needing to check in every hour

Adaptable — new SOPs will land in your lap regularly. You learn fast and don't panic when the process changes

Fast without being sloppy — speed matters, but not at the cost of quality





Volume & Schedule



We'll start with 15-20 hours/week of SOP-based tasks

As you prove yourself and new processes come online, this will grow — potentially to full-time

You set your own hours as long as deliverables hit the deadline

We care about output, not clock-watching

title: Business Automation Analyst
description:
Business Automation Analyst | US-Based MSP | 100% Remote | Full-Time



If your first instinct when doing something manually is “this shouldn’t be manual” — keep reading.



To apply please fill out the application form here: 
/bepartofourteam.



About the Company



We’re a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We’ve been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We’ve grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.



The Role



You’re not here to maintain spreadsheets. You’re here to question why the spreadsheet exists — and build the system that makes it unnecessary.



We’re looking for a Business Automation Analyst who sees manual work as a problem to be solved, not a process to be managed. You’ll analyze how work gets done across the business, identify what’s slow, repetitive, or error-prone, and build the systems that fix it permanently. Python, advanced Excel, AI-powered workflows, and smart automation tools are your toolkit. The outcome is a business that runs faster, reports more accurately, and depends less on manual effort over time.



The Mindset We’re Looking For



The best analysts we’ve worked with share a few traits:



They see a manual process and immediately ask: “Why is someone doing this by hand — and what would it take to make sure no one ever has to again?”

They take ownership. From the 
nt a process improvement is theirs, it’s theirs until it’s built, documented, and running without them.

They think upstream. Instead of asking “how do I make this faster?” they ask “why does this exist, and should it?”

They communicate clearly. Progress, blockers, and outcomes are shared openly — before being asked for.

They keep learning. Twelve months from now, they know more than they do today — without anyone telling them to.



Who Thrives Here



People who are operationally sharp, intellectually curious, and genuinely excited by the idea of making a business run better.



You don’t need someone to hand you a list of things to automate — you find them yourself. You’re comfortable with ambiguity, resourceful with tools, and you care more about outcomes than staying in your lane.



We’re a growing MSP, which means not every process is optimized and not every workflow is documented yet. For the right person, that’s not a gap — it’s the whole point.



What You’ll Do



You’ll walk into a business that has real operational inefficiencies — manual reports, repetitive data work, processes that exist because “that’s how we’ve always done it.” Your job is to find them, understand them, and systematically eliminate them.



That looks like:



Mapping workflows that rely on human hands and asking which ones shouldn’t — then building the automations that replace them

Building Python scripts, data pipelines, and AI-powered workflows that turn hours of manual work into something that runs itself

Creating Excel models and dashboards that give leadership accurate, real-time visibility — not end-of-week summaries compiled by hand

Digging into messy, multi-source datasets and producing clean, reliable outputs that people actually trust

Documenting everything you build so clearly that someone else could maintain it, improve it, or build on top of it — without asking you a single question

Sitting with teams, understanding how they actually work, and translating that into automation solutions that fit the way they operate — not the other way around

Continuously looking for the next thing to improve, because the work is never finished — it just gets better



What We’re Looking For



Strong Python programming skills — you don’t just write scripts that work, you write scripts that others can read, maintain, and build on

Advanced Excel expertise (required) — Pivot Tables, Power Query, complex formulas, dashboards, data validation; you treat Excel as a serious tool, not a last resort

Solid experience with SQL and database querying — you can get to the data you need without waiting for someone else to pull it

Hands-on experience with AI tools and workflow automation platforms — you’ve actually built things with them, not just read about them

Experience with Zapier, Make, n8n, Power Automate, or similar tools — you know when to code and when not to

Strong diagnostic skills — you find the root cause of an operational problem, not just the most obvious fix

Natural systems thinker — you look at a process and immediately see how it should be redesigned, not just optimized

Self-directed once you understand the environment — but you ask smart questions early to get there

Honest communicator — you say what’s happening clearly and on time, even when the update isn’t good news

Long-term mindset — you want to build something, not just fill a role



Nice to Have



API integration experience

Background in MSP, IT services, or operations-heavy environments



How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)



We’re honest about how we work with new tea
mbers.



In your first weeks and months, you’ll have real hands-on support from the team. We’ll work closely with you to understand how the business operates, our tools, our standards, and where the biggest opportunities are. We expect questions — and we’ll give you the time to learn.



As you show what you can do — and you will — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership, judgment, and quality work earn autonomy quickly. People who consistently deliver end up with significant latitude to shape their systems, their tools, and how the business runs.



We don’t want to over-direct people who don’t need it. But we also don’t believe in throwing someone in without context and calling it autonomy. We earn each other’s trust through real work — then we get out of the way.



What Success Looks Like



At 3 months:



You’ve mapped the highest-impact manual processes in the business and have at least two automation solutions live and running

Your documentation is already being used by others



At 6 months:



Reporting workflows that used to take hours run themselves

Teams are spending less time on manual data work and more time on decisions

You’ve identified the next wave of improvements without being asked



At 12 months:



The business operates measurably faster and more accurately than before you joined

You’ve built systems that others rely on — and you’re already improving them again



How We Work



We trust our people to do great work and we give them the space to do it.



There’s real work to be done — the business depends on it — but we understand that doing meaningful work means making decisions, and sometimes those decisions won’t be right on the first try. That’s how we find the right path. We don’t punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn from them and move forward.



We’re a growing MSP, so not every system is perfect yet and not every process is documented. That’s part of why we need someone like you — to help us build the automations, processes, and systems that make us better as we grow.



This Role Is Not for You If:



You need a detailed task list to know what to work on

You build something once and consider it done

You document only when asked

You’re more comfortable maintaining existing systems than questioning why they exist

Your outside commitments regularly affect your availability and focus

You’re looking for predictable, low-ambiguity work with clear daily instructions



There’s no judgment in that list — it’s just not the environment. We’d rather be honest now than waste each other’s time.



What We Offer



Competitive salary based on experience

100% remote — no corporate commute, ever

Weekly pay via Wise direct deposit

Tech and internet allowance

Paid vacation leave

HMO

Access to the latest AI tools (Claude, Cursor, and more) to work smarter and automate more

Career growth opportunities in a fast-moving, systems-focused environment

title: Customer and Collections Support - UK experience preferred!
description:
If you have experience in customer support — particularly handling payments, arrears, complaints, or sensitive financial situations for UK-based companies — and you’re ready to grow into a collections role at a fast-moving fintech startup, this role is for you.



Apply here: 
/appqyBZJyyxs1htVk/pagvvCsolTY5tzwa7/form



About Us

We are a fast-growing fintech team delivering flexible payment solutions, including Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) services, that help customers manage their everyday payments with ease. Our team thrives on collaboration, innovation, and a customer-first mindset. If you’re looking for a role where your work genuinely matters and your growth is part of the plan, you’ve found it.



What You’ll Do

As a Collections & Customer Operations Agent, you’ll be the go-to person for our customers — helping them with payments, resolving account issues, and keeping things on track. AI drives a large part of how we work, but your judgment is what makes it effective. You’ll be responsible for feeding it the right context, reviewing outputs before they reach customers, and stepping in when something needs a human call. We move fast and hold each other to a high standard, so you’ll be expected to bring your best every day, take feedback in stride, and keep moving forward.



IMPORTANT: Please carefully read the responsibilities below to ensure you’re a good fit, and follow the instructions on how to apply at the bottom.



Big Plus — UK Customer Support Experience: If you’ve worked for a UK-based company supporting customers through payments, arrears, complaints, financial hardship, escalations, or sensitive account issues — even if your title wasn’t “collections” — this is exactly the experience we’re looking for.



Compensation:

* Competitive salary: $1,300 – $1,500 USD per month (depending on experience)

* Opportunity to grow into a senior or team lead position as the support team expands



Benefits:

* 100% Remote — work from anywhere in the Philippines

* 15 days paid leave

* Semi-monthly salary payouts

* Paid time off and Philippine public holidays

* Supportive, startup-style culture where your ideas matter

* Clear growth path and strong learning opportunities in fintech



Working Hours:

* Shift during onboarding: 11:00 AM – 6:00 PM UK time, Monday to Friday. After onboarding, a fixed schedule will be provided depending on business needs.

* Must be willing to work during weekends

* This is a full-time role only (40 hours per week)



Core Responsibilities

* Deliver exceptional multi-channel support (chat,
, and phone) with a focus on first-contact resolution and high customer satisfaction.

* Uphold brand standards by communicating clearly, consistently, and professionally in all interactions.

* Actively manage brand reputation by professionally responding to all customer reviews and public feedback.

* Handle and resolve customer complaints with empathy and efficiency, knowing when and how to appropriately escalate complex issues.

* Oversee customer repayments and collections by assisting with payment management, rescheduling, and account oversight with professionalism and care.

* Protect the business by proactively identifying, investigating, and escalating suspicious activity and potential fraud cases.

* Work extensively with AI-driven tools as a core part of your daily workflow. This is a very AI-forward role, so genuine comfort and curiosity with AI is a must.

* Build a real understanding of our processes — not just rely on AI outputs. Speed matters, but so does knowing the reasoning behind what you’re doing.



You’re Perfect for This Role If You

* Have experience in customer support, ideally with a UK-based company, handling payments, arrears, complaints, financial hardship, escalations, or sensitive customer situations — even if your job title wasn’t specifically “collections.”

* Are familiar with collections, repayments, and debt management concepts, and can balance speed with accuracy and empathy under pressure.

* Welcome honest, direct feedback and see it as a tool for getting better, not something to take personally.

* Hold yourself to a high standard of integrity. This role gives you immediate access to sensitive financial data, and trust is non-negotiable.

* Are proficient with AI tools and a quick learner when it comes to automation and new technology.

* Thrive in a fast-paced, customer-first startup environment where priorities shift quickly.

* Are an empathetic problem solver with strong attention to detail, professionalism, and integrity.



Nice to Have:

* Direct experience in a collections, BNPL, or lending role (any market).

* Prior experience supporting UK customers in financial services, utilities, or telecoms.

* Familiarity with UK consumer financial regulations or guidelines around vulnerable customers and arrears handling.



How to Apply:

* Click the link below to submit your application and let’s get started: 
/appqyBZJyyxs1htVk/pagvvCsolTY5tzwa7/form

title: Funnel Builder Wanted — Join a Steadily Growing E-Commerce Business
description:
We're Techtail, a steadily growing e-commerce business in the Beauty and Health space, selling across multiple European markets. We run high-converting direct-response funnels and we need someone who can build them fast, clean, and with a creative eye for copy and layout that sells.



This is a full-time role. We start with a 1 month paid trial period to make sure it's a good fit for both sides, after that you're part of the team with bonuses and room to grow!



----



1) What You'll Be Doing



You'll join our funnel building team, creating complete product funnels inside Funnelish. We don't copy competitors, we build our sales pages from scratch using ChatGPT and our own frameworks.



- Creating original, high-converting sales pages using ChatGPT and our copywriting frameworks

- Writing headlines, product descriptions, and CTAs that actually sell

- Rolling out each funnel in multiple European languages using AI translation tools (you don't need to speak these languages)

- Editing product images in Canva 

- Being creative: new angles, better hooks, smarter product positioning, improving the templates



2) What We're Looking For

- Creative thinking: you improve on instructions, not just follow them

- Experience with Funnelish, or similar platforms

- Comfortable with Canva or Photoshop

- Fluent English

- Detail-oriented, fast, and reliable



3) What's In It For You



- Full-time position with a paid trial period

- Competitive hourly pay, paid bi-weekly via Wise

- Performance bonuses of up to 30 percent per winning product

- All tools and software provided

- Real creative freedom in how funnels are presented

- Room to grow into senior roles or team lead positions

- Structured learning environment with a motivated team that helps each other improve



----



4) How to Apply



- Start your application with the word "watermelon"

- Please include samples of funnels you've built (preferably in English and European languages)



If you love e-commerce, write copy that converts, and want creative ownership in a growing team, we want to hear from you.



Note: applications will be reviewed after 3 weeks. We'll reach out to shortlisted candidates after that.

title: Amazon Listing Specialist & Catalog Management (Big EU account)
description:
PLEASE READ CAREFULLY BEFORE APPLYING – Applications that do not follow the instructions below will not be considered.



---



POSITION: Amazon EU Marketplace Operations Specialist – Flat Files, Variations & Seller Central

Remote (Philippines-based preferred)

Full-Time | Permanent | Long-Term



---

IMPORTANT:



"Please write your application in your own words. We can spot AI-generated cover letters immediately, and they will be disqualified without further review. A short, honest, human-written message tells us far more about you than a polished AI response ever could. Which will all sound the same and make it hard to assess if somebody actually does have the skillset we need. It will be a waste of everybodys time. And therefore we will prefer manual written ones over AI written ones."



---



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are an established European e-commerce company with our primary focus on Amazon EU. Our largest marketplace is Amazon Germany, where we operate with over 1,100+ proprietary SKUs across all relevant EU marketplaces.



We are a growing European Amazon brand with an established presence across multiple EU marketplaces (UK, DE, FR, IT, ES, NL, BE, SE, PL and others). We are looking for a highly experienced Amazon Operations Specialist who lives and breathes Seller Central – someone for whom flat files, variation merging, and bulk uploads are second nature, not something they "have experience with."



This is not a management or oversight role. This is a hands-on, execution-focused specialist position. You will be in Seller Central every single day.



We are not looking for someone who knows their way around Amazon in general. We are looking for someone who has done exactly this work – day in, day out – and can execute it efficiently, reliably, and autonomously without needing to be guided through it.



---



WHAT YOU WILL DO



• Upload new main images, A+ Content, and video assets across EU marketplaces with the correct methods per market

• Manage content uploads carefully across synchronized and non-synchronized marketplaces to prevent content from overwriting other markets unintentionally

• Handle flat file creation, editing, and bulk uploads with full confidence

• Manage parent-child variation structures – creating, merging, troubleshooting, and maintaining them

• Activate and troubleshoot listings across EU marketplaces

• Perform data manipulation tasks directly in Seller Central and via flat files

• Handle listing suppressions, errors, and content rejections independently

• Coordinate uploads of language-specific content (images, A+, video) per marketplace

• Keep a clean, organized workflow across a high volume of SKUs



---



THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF...



You have done this exact work – not supervised it, not assisted with it – you have done it yourself, daily, as a specialist



The following scenarios cause you zero hesitation:

- A flat file bulk upload throws a "8572 – The value for 'parentage' is invalid" error on 40 SKUs. You know exactly what happened and how to fix it.

- You need to update A+ Content on the German marketplace without it syncing to and overwriting the French marketplace version. You know the exact steps.

- A parent-child variation has collapsed and child ASINs are floating as standalone listings. You know how to re-merge them.

- You are uploading a video that needs to appear on DE and NL but NOT on FR due to content restrictions. You handle this routinely.

-> YOU need to know it, not how to look it up. Otherwise the position will end again after a week.



If any of the above made you pause and think – this role is likely not the right fit.



---



REQUIREMENTS



• Minimum 3 years of hands-on Amazon Seller Central experience (EU marketplaces strongly preferred!)

• Expert-level knowledge of flat files (all major categories and all tricks and shortcuts)

• Deep experience with parent-child variation creation, merging, and troubleshooting

• Proven experience managing multi-marketplace EU content uploads

• Strong understanding of Amazon's content hierarchy and marketplace sync logic

• Experience with listing activations and suppression troubleshooting

• High attention to detail and ability to manage large SKU volumes

• Reliable internet connection and availability during European business hours (at least partial overlap)



PLUS: Experience with DataDive for analytical work and keyword/listing optimization



---



WHAT WE OFFER



• Full-time, permanent position in a very stable company existing since 25 years

• Stable, long-term collaboration with a professional European team

• Competitive salary based on experience and output

• A role where your expertise is genuinely valued – we don't need someone to learn this; we need someone who already masters it

• Fully flexible hours (you dont need to align with us regularly)



---



HOW TO APPLY



To be considered, your application MUST include:



1. A detailed CV including all relevant Amazon experience (please specify: which marketplaces, which tools, what volume of SKUs you managed)

2. Your current employment status – are you actively employed, freelancing, or available immediately?

3. Confirmation that this is the type of work you do routinely and independently, not occasionally or under supervision

4. Your full-time salary expectation

5. A brief description of a real flat file or variation challenge you have solved

6. Please briefly explain why you are looking to change your current position – or, if you are currently between roles, why your last employment ended. We are not looking for a perfect answer; we are looking for an honest one.



IMPORTANT: Your application title or opening line MUST include the word "Knock-Knock". Applications without this will not be opened. This is our way of confirming that you read this posting carefully – exactly the kind of attention to detail we expect from the person in this role.



---



We are looking to hire quickly. If this describes your daily work – we want to hear from you.

title: Tiktok Shop Operations Manager
description:
Faccelove is a fast-growing e-commerce beauty brand serving thousands of customers worldwide every day. Our mission is to help people preserve and enhance their natural beauty through innovative products and meaningful brand experiences.



The Role: 



You'll own the architecture, operations, and health of our TikTok Shop presence in the US (and eventually DACH/UK as TikTok Shop rolls out). This is not a content or creative role this is the person who makes sure the store works, stays compliant, ships on time, and scales without breaking. You'll be the operational backbone behind every creator video, live, and affiliate push.



What you'll own:



Setup & Infrastructure:



- Set up and maintain TikTok Shop seller accounts (US first, DACH/UK later)

- Product catalog management: listings, variants, pricing, inventory sync, SEO-optimized PDPs

- Integrate TikTok Shop with our Shopify backend, 3PL, and inventory systems

- Configure shipping templates, return policies, tax settings, and payment flows



Operations & Logistics



- Manage order flow from TikTok Shop ? 3PL ? customer, ensuring SLAs are hit

- Monitor inventory levels and forecast restocks against creator/live campaign spikes

- Coordinate with our logistics partners on fulfillment, returns, and customs (for cross-border)

- Own dispatch times, late shipment rates, and on-time delivery metrics



Store Health & Compliance



- Keep shop health scores in the green: violation monitoring, appeals, policy compliance

- Stay on top of TikTok Shop policy changes (cosmetics category is highly regulated ingredient claims, before/after, FTC, etc.)

- Manage product approvals, category certifications, and any documentation TikTok requires

- Prevent and resolve account suspensions, listing takedowns, and penalty points



Customer Support



- Own TikTok Shop's in-app customer service: response time, CSAT, dispute resolution

- Build SOPs and (eventually) train/manage a CS rep as volume scales

- Handle refunds, returns, and escalations within TikTok's policies



Reporting



- Weekly dashboard: GMV, AOV, conversion, shop health, return rate, CS metrics

- Flag risks early (inventory, compliance, account health) before they hit revenue



Must-haves:



- 2+ years hands-on TikTok Shop operations (US market strongly preferred)

- Has personally set up a TikTok Shop from scratch — not just managed an existing one

- Knows the seller backend cold: Seller Center, Affiliate Center, Creator Marketplace

- Understands usage rights, whitelisting, and Spark Ads from the ecommerce side - Familiar with cosmetics/beauty category restrictions on TikTok Shop (big plus)

- Experience integrating TikTok Shop with Shopify and a 3PL

- Comfortable with shop health management, appeals, and compliance documentation

- Self-directed, structured, comfortable with async work and Slack/ClickUp/Notion



Nice-to-haves:



- TikTok Shop experience in DACH or UK markets

- Background in beauty, skincare, or regulated DTC categories

- Experience running or supporting TikTok LIVE shopping

- Familiarity with Meta Shop and other social commerce platforms



What’s in it for you?



Competitive salary

On-time and reliable payments

Opportunity to work with a fast-growing global e-commerce brand

Long-term growth opportunities
